blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: The Patrol desk gives you an idea of how to play the game, and the basic controls involved with it. You don't need to worry about damages, you can't get a star rating for either of these, and a good majority of the clues etc. There are 309 clues in the game, 95% is 294, so that's the magic number.

blocks.title: Crime Scene
paragraphs: You get a call about a shooting in an alleyway. Drive towards the yellow dot on your map, which is the location of the crime scene. When you approach the alleyway, a scene will trigger. You'll be asked to find the murder weapon, and told the victim has been carted off to the morgue already. Follow your partner through the crime scene, getting used to hearing the chime for the clues and manipulating objects by picking up a bottle and moving it around. When you're used to it, pick up newspaper #1 and take a look at the story behind the scene.
The newspapers seem a little bit random at first, but they add a lot to the plot of this game. I'll point them out throughout the guide anyway.

Afterwards, your partner, Dunn, shouts you over. Go check out the bloodied up door to get your first official clue Bloodstain. To get used to things, hit the back button to check your notebook, where you'll see evidence, people, and locations. Evidence views your clues, people is the P-O-Is (persons of interest) involved in the case, and locations are things like the crime scene or the houses of the victims, etc.

Continue down the alley, left of the door. Head past the dumpster for another chime, which shows Cole looking up and seeing the reflection of the revolver. You are prompted to find a drainpipe or ladder to climb onto the roof. Follow the alley around to the left and there is a drainpipe on the left. Walk up to it to start climbing. On the roof, find the Smith & Wesson revolver lying there. Manipulate it to see the name and serial number, which zooms in. Don't worry, you don't need to remember, they'll all be added to your notebook. Manipulate it further to flip open the barrel, two rounds have been fired. You get the gun as a clue, and the music stops playing, meaning you've found everything. Climb down, and chat with Dunn. Phelps has ambition and wants to get the gunman himself. Sure, it's probably not his game, but why not? You get the gun store in your locations.

blocks.title: Gun store
paragraphs: Set the destination to the gun store and drive there. When you arrive, you'll see the door of the shop has a gold handle. This means you can enter (or interact) with this door. Head in and chat with the store owner. He sold the Revolver that you found and then proves it by handing you the gun store ledger. Open it and you're looking for the serial number that Phelps says. It's the fifth entry down. Tap it to find it was sold to an Errol Schroeder. This adds Errol to your POI list and his apartment to your destinations. It also triggers a new objective.

blocks.title: Errol Schroeder's Apartment
paragraphs: Head to the destination, and walk up the stairs. Examining the mailbox on the left gives you the apartment number, 2, upstairs. Head up and head for the door. After knocking, the door is answered by Schroeder and you talk. When asked about the gun, he admits to owning the revolver, but when asked about the shooting he claims no knowledge, saying he has the gun. When he goes to produce it however, it isn't in the drawer. Cole goes to arrest him, but Schroeder won't go quietly and decks Dunn. You get involved in your first brawl.

Hold LT to lock on and use A to punch, and X to dodge. When prompted, hit B and finish the fight off, allowing Phelps to cuff him. Now you get to search the apartment. The only bit of useful searching however, comes from the drawer near to where Schroeder attempted to produce the gun from, where you find Schroeder's Notebook. Dunn suggests ignoring this evidence however, as it 'stirs the hornet's nest'. After this, Cole calls in the arrest and the case ends.

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: This case is nice and quick, and isn't really a case, but teaches you about gunfights. You get a call for an armed robbery at Westlake Savings & Loan. Head straight to it, you'll automatically have your sirens blaring and traffic will move out of your way.

When you arrive you get a short cutscene, where the gunmen open fire on your car. Cole retrieves a shotgun from the boot of the car and the gunfight begins. You start in cover. Pressing LT to aim will poke your head out of cover and allow you to take damage, but gives you chance to line up a decent shot. When you take damage, your screen will start to go grey and you begin hearing a heartbeat. Hide in cover for a while to regain health. You can blind fire by shooting without aiming. The M1917 is only available at this time.

Gun down the men outside the bank, and then leg it to more cover just outside the bank. There is another gunman behind a column on the left, one behind a desk in the center and a third on the balcony above the desk. Pick them off to end the mission.

weaponOpportunities.note: You start with it in Armed and Dangerous; it can also be taken from the boot of any police car.

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Another short, simple case that's not a case. This time we're learning how to pursue criminals. As you're driving along, Dunn notices a wanted criminal. He orders you to get after him on foot while he tries to cut him off in the car.

Chase after the guy. When you reach small fences, or other such objects throughout the game, simply running into them triggers Phelps to climb them and get over. Chase Bowers down the alley until Dunn cuts him off in the car. Bowers veers left. If you lose sight of him, look for the red dot on your map. Climb the fire escape ladder that he climbs and follow him up to the roof. Chase him to the drainpipe and climb after him. Get too close and you'll be kicked back here, so don't worry about catching him on the pipe. Jump off the ledge at the top by running at the gap like you did the fence earlier. Climb to the next roof, across another gap, and, if you've not caught up to Bowers yet, he will hide around a corner and take Phelps out with a nice clothesline. This signals a brawl, which I think you owe him some pay back.

You can end the fight two ways, either by standard knockout like the previous brawl, or by forcing Bowers off the edge of the roof, plummeting to the floor below. Doesn't matter which you do, either way ends the case. Dunn talks to you about whichever option you decide to take afterwards, but either way, this wraps up this case.

cases.title: Buyer Beware
objectives: Search the Crime Scene and talk to the witness

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: This case is the first true case of the game, where you control interrogations as well as doing everything to do with the evidence. You still don't get a rating for it, so don't worry just yet.

Phelps hears a gunshot while out on the beat. He races round the corner, and is first on the scene for the shooting. Dunn tells Phelps to take control of the investigation while he sets up a perimeter.

blocks.title: Nunn Bush Shoes
paragraphs: You get the shooting clue automatically when the case starts. You're standing over the victim's body. Check his jacket pocket by moving Phelp's hand over the correct area and hitting A. Usually there are 6 areas that can be checked, depending on the nature of the victim's corpse. The head, both hands, body, and either side's jacket pocket. Pull the Layaway Voucher out of the pocket, and scroll down to get the clue added to your inventory. It shows a series of payments made to C. Galletta on some pearl earrings.

Next, head towards the curb to see a glint on the floor. When you hear the chime, examine and pick up the .32 shell casings. Head down the road to the crowd of people being held back by a uniformed officer next to a trash can. Examine the trash can for the FN Browning handgun, and examine it for the serial number. Phelps says he should run it by a gun store, and Eagleton's gun store is provided by Dunn.

Head to the other end of the sidewalk, past the body and a man in a red shirt says he heard the gunshot and saw a young lady run into the shop. You have all your clues, so enter the shop to speak to the girl.

Interrogations are the same style most of the time. Usually, you get a little bit of a cutscene, Cole introducing himself and asking if he can question. Then, your notebook automatically comes up with a list of questions. The only topic you get on this one at first is "Eyewitness Account", and it's a tutorial so you can't fail.

blocks.title: Clovis Galletta

topics.response: Choose Eyewitness Account. She will feed you a story about how she was being accosted in another shop by her boss, and walked ahead. She heard the gunshots and turned and Mr. Gage was dead.

This time, the tutorial asks for you to hit bad cop. She is once again glancing from side to side, and looks nervous, so bad cop it is, as you have no evidence against what she says, but she is holding back something. Hit X, and she reveals that there may be a religious motive in the shooting as Kalou is Jewish and Gage hated Jews.

When pressed for details on how many shots she heard, she says she can't really remember, but she holds your gaze and seems honest. Answer Good Cop, and Phelps coaxes the information out of her. After the interrogation, you speak to Dunn and you get the objective to go to Hartfield's Jewelry Store. However, if you want to really get this case sorted properly, go to Eagleson's Gun Store first.

paragraphs: Watch her actions as and after she speaks. She looks a little uncomfortable, glancing from side to side and licking her lips. So she's definitely not telling the whole truth. So that leaves bad cop or accuse. However, it is a tutorial, and you are told it is a accuse so hit Y.

Your notebook pops up with your list of evidence. You want to select Layaway Voucher. When you select it, you hear a little musical chime to say you got it right, it is three notes that ascend and you will love that noise. If you get an answer wrong at any point, it is a four note, somber tone that infuriates you.
She gives a full story, including adding Mr. Kalou as a POI and the Jewelry Store as a location. Two more topics are added to this questioning though.

blocks.title: Eagleson's Gun Store
paragraphs: Chat with the store owner, who tells you the gun is popular in Europe, and he doesn't sell it. However, he does remember cleaning one up a couple of weeks prior, and it belonged to a Mr.Kalou. If you failed the previous interview, then you get the information regarding Kalou's identity as the murderer. So it's time to go get him.

blocks.title: Hartfield's Jewelery
paragraphs: Enter the store and speak to the guy behind the counter. After saying he will go find Kalou, the man pegs it through the back door. It's Kalou, Phelps! Get after him! This is a short tutorial on warning shots. During chases where you have your gun produced, like this one, you can fire a warning shot, provided you can hold the suspect at gunpoint long enough. Get to a long open stretch where Kalou won't round a corner and hold the aim button (LT). You will start to aim and a gauge will fill up if you hold it over Kalou's still running form. Fill the gauge and the chase will stop, you'll have apprehended the suspect. If you don't manage to apprehend him, don't worry, as the chase ends when Kalou gets blocked by a multi-car pile-up.

topics.instruction: Argument With Gage: Accuse - Suspect Positively Identified
topics.response: If you correctly branched Galletta's questions earlier in the case, then you get this as your opening gambit. Kalou states that he dislikes Gage, but has no reason to shoot the man. Call him a liar and provide the statement gained from Galletta, and Kalou begins to crack, mentioning the Anti-Semitism that gives you your next topic.

topics.instruction: Nunn Bush shooting incident: Accuse - Murder Weapon Serviced (Only pops up if you did not get the information out of Galletta)
topics.response: If you incorrectly branched Galletta's questions, you can still continue the case, but your opening question is about the shooting. Use the information from the Gun Store to prove that Kalou's weapon was used in the attack.

After asking more about the Jewish angle, Kalou clams up, and says he knows nothing about what you're talking about. Unfortunately, you have no evidence, so hit bad cop and Phelp's puts a little more pressure on, causing Kalou to snap. You have your motive, and Cole charges Kalou there and then.

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Meet Stefan Bekowsky, your new partner. I much preferred Dunn, because his name is easier to type. Stefan works the traffic desk in the Downtown Central part of LA, which covers a wide area. With that, you'll be given your first case as a detective, an abandoned vehicle with signs of foul play, so head there immediately.

blocks.title: P.E. Freight Depot
paragraphs: After you arrive at the scene of the crime, you will be greeted by a uniformed police officer. After a brief conversation, where you learn you have a witness, named Nate Wilkey, you will be given an opportunity to investigate the area.

Firstly, speak to Malcolm Carruthers, the coroner. You'll see a lot of this guy, and he is vital to understanding what happens in a criminal's mind. He points you to look at the inside of the car, which is covered in Blood Splashes. Looks like whatever happened was a messy ordeal. No victim around though, unless he's in the trunk of the car. Finish looking at the blooded interior and head for the boot.

In the trunk, you'll find a tire iron, which holds no value, and a receipt for a live Hog, from Riverside Slaughterhouse. The place has no meaning, but it was sold to a Mr. F Morgan, who is added to your POI list.

Next, in front of the car, next to a little yellow marker, is two pieces of evidence. First, examine the wallet, which has a driver's license for Adrian Black in it, as well as confirms his address and his marital status. Cole suggests his wife must be spoken to, and you get the objective and location of the Black residence. You can examine the lovely photograph on the right as well.
Put the wallet down and pick up the Glasses. Rotate them until you see the word Stenzel and it zooms in. Cole remarks on the home repairs carried out on them.

Next, head to another marker across the tracks, where you find a Blooded Pipe. Examine this to see the name of the company who supplied it, Instaheat. Worth looking into, wonder if they know their pipes have blood on them?
The music cue should sound now, so it's time to interview your witness.

blocks.title: Nate Wilkey

topics.instruction: Purpose at the Scene: Good Cop
topics.response: Nate's an honest man, heading out for work when he stumbles upon this car. Believe him, and he'll tell you that nobody else was around until the police showed up.

topics.instruction: Knowledge of Adrian Black: Good Cop
topics.response: Nate doesn't know who Black is, and tells Phelps as much. When you admit he's telling the truth, he says he'd seen the car parked in the car park a few nights before, and it stood out.

When asked about the bloodied pipe, he says he doesn't know about it, he holds your gaze like before. Believe him, and he'll say that the blood in the car looked dark and dry when he got there, indicating the actual deed happened elsewhere, and this is just where the car was abandoned.

This is the first time Nate gets riled up about anything, a sure fire thing that he's not telling the truth. When the contents of the wallet are brought up, he loses his cool and goes on the defensive. You have no evidence, however, so just use bad cop, and he'll admit to looking through the wallet but finding no money.

paragraphs: After you interview the individual, speak to the uniformed officer. It's time to head to the Black Residence.

blocks.title: Black Residence
paragraphs: After you arrive at the Black residence, you will have a brief conversation with Mrs. Black. After the conversation, you will be given an opportunity to look around the home.

Head straight for Adrian's Bedroom, which has 4 of the clues you need. Adrian's is next to the kitchen and looks rather worse for wear. Take a look at the wardrobe for the Train Ticket to Seattle. Somebody seems eager to leave. Next, the dresser has a Glasses Case, and it is once again from Stenzel when you open it. With the case on the dresser is a picture of Adrian. If you examine this further by pressing A, you discover that Adrian doesn't only have his wife who loves him, by finding a Concealed Message from a Nicole. On the bedside drawers is a Matchbook from Cavanagh's Bar. You can trace this address to follow up the bar lead afterward.

In the kitchen, there is a table with a few items on it. First, pick up the Instaheat Receipt, which gives you the knowledge that the Blacks do have an Instaheat Water Heater that the pipe may have belonged to. Also, pick up the flyer next to it, as it gives another clue, Instaheat Flyer.

Before we leave to go outside like Cole suggests, look on the dining room table for the next newspaper (#2) and listen to the story behind the headlines. Also, find the phone in the house (the location is marked on your map) and call in your request for an address for Cavanagh's.

Finally, head outside to the Water Heater around the side of the building. You'll have to solve a quick puzzle by matching the correct shaped pipe to the correct area. When you put all the available pipes in, you find you are missing a pipe, and it matches the pipe you found at the crime scene. Suspicious!

blocks.title: Margaret Black

topics.response: When asked about the Receipt found in the car, she has no knowledge of it, saying Black works in the tools business. She do, s however, identify Frank Morgan, the name on the Receipt. She holds your gaze as she speaks, so it's true. She explains that Morgan is a very shady character and Adrian's drinking buddy.

Cole asks if Adrian was wearing his glasses when he left. She replies yes, and says he'd just bought a new pair. Again, she's being truthful. She then goes on to say she had urged him to throw away his old, taped glasses, the ones you found at the scene.

topics.instruction: Location of Adrian Black: Good Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks if she knew where Adrian was going last night. She says for a drink with Frank, and seems honest, if a little sad. When asked, she says that he returned home early, which was uncharacteristic apparently, and left early for the bar.

Cole asks about the photo, and Mrs. Black looks very shifty when replying about his business trip in Seattle. You know about the message, so confront her with it, and she says she is aware of the affair, and that there is another woman.
Apparently, Adrian practically lives at the Bar, and you've no reason to doubt this statement. She goes on to say that he hasn't been there as much lately, as he has been in Seattle.

topics.instruction: Alibi for Mrs Black: Good Cop
topics.response: Mrs Black apparently made dinner and waited for her husband. This appears sincere, so give her the benefit, despite her not having any witnesses to prove she was home. She's been through a lot bless her.

paragraphs: After your conversation with Mrs. Black, fast travel to Cavanagh's Bar.

blocks.title: Cavanagh's Bar
paragraphs: Chat with the barman on entering and he'll tell you that Morgan is sat at the back of the room. Head to him and strike up a conversation. He doesn't sound very concerned about the welfare of his drinking buddy.

blocks.title: Frank Morgan

topics.instruction: Link to Abandoned Vehicle: Accuse - Receipt for Live Hog
topics.response: Frank Morgan is a pretty good liar, but not good enough. He claims no knowledge of the abandoned vehicle, but you have his signature on a bit of paper found in the car to prove he knows about it. Bring it up, and Morgan cracks quickly.

topics.instruction: Location of Adrian Black: Bad Cop
topics.response: When asked about the location of Black, Morgan claims he left for Seattle. The correct answer is Bad Cop, despite the fact you have the train ticket as evidence (which I always thought the fact the ticket was at home meant he wasn't in Seattle, but alas, I was wrong). Phelps and Stefan get rough on him, and Morgan reveals that he is at his house, and hands over his address.

paragraphs: Topic (If you incorrectly answered topic 1): Knowledge of Adrian Black: Accuse - Receipt for Live Hog
If you didn't mention the receipt, you can still get the information out of him with this second question. Use the same evidence against him, and you'll get it this time.

Note: If you get the last question wrong, and don't get the information from Morgan, you get a final chance to redeem yourself by tailing him back to his apartment. Take it nice and steady, stay at a nice distance away from him, and don't cause any havoc which will cause him to become suspicious.
If you get the questions correct, which you should if you're following this guide, then you get the option to arrest Morgan, or let him go. I'd arrest him, just because he's got a smug face.

Now, it's time to go to Morgan's flat. If you get into your police car, you'll get a call from KGPL regarding the blood in the car. According to tests, the blood isn't human (surprise surprise), and is most likely from a swine. It does not matter if you or your partner drive.
Morgan's Apartment

Head in, check the mailbox to see that Morgan is in apartment 2, and head up the stairs. Knock on the door, and guess who answers? Mr Black himself! He says he'll come quietly, but then slams the door and runs for it. Run at the door to kick it open, then head for the window and onto the fire escape ladder. Black went up, so climb after him to the roof. Run across the roof, jump a couple of gaps, slide down a drainpipe and you'll see Black being held at gunpoint by Stefan. Case closed.

paragraphs: When you arrive at the crime scene, speak to the two police officers to get some background info.
Now go and question the man sat on the porch, Oswald Jacobs.

blocks.title: You are now given the two clues: Mexican Suspect and Old Ford

topics.instruction: Vehicle stripped of parts: Bad Cop
topics.response: After the interview, examine the porch to find a clue (Valdez's Notebook) on the bench.

paragraphs: Head to the gamewell and return to Central Police Station.

paragraphs: Speak to the watch officer and head to room 2.

topics.instruction: Association with Gabriel: Accuse (Evidence is Valdez's Notebook)
topics.response: Return to the watch officer before leaving.

clues.name: Missing wrench; match the wrenches to the wall mount.

paragraphs: Speak to the owner and head to the garage.
Examine the plates on same wall.

topics.instruction: Association with Valdez: Accuse (Evidence is alleged bribery or Valdez's notebook)
Whereabouts of Del Gado: Bad Cop
Wrench used in auto theft: Bad Cop

clues.name: Flag, on the living room table

paragraphs: Examine the post on the floor to get Del Gado's room number. Head upstairs and search the property.
Examine the picture of Gabriel and his car on the cabinet near the kitchen.

topics.instruction: Last contact with Gabriel: Accuse (Evidence: breakfast plates or stolen Argentinian flag)

topics.response: Head to the street race and chase the red Ford. Eventually, you can apprehend him by pointing your gun at him.

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: At the start of this case, you get to witness a hit and run incident involving a man and a red car. The car takes out the man, and roars off into the night.

Your Captain sends Phelps and Bekowsky out to the scene of the incident, just outside Ray's Cafe on North Los Angeles Street. Head out of the station and fast travel there. From your briefing, you get the clue Hit and Run Vehicle.

blocks.title: Ray's Cafe
paragraphs: On arrival, speak to the uniformed officer to get a few bits of information. Victim is Lester Pattison, hit by a car as he stepped out into the street. Female witness, Shannon Perry, is available to interview, but you'll want to scout the area first.

Let's start with the body. If you look in the right breast pocket, you'll find the wallet clue. This will add Pattison's address to your locations. In the other pocket you'll find an insurance letter from Fire and Life, showing that his premiums have gone up. Good job really.

Back out from your examination of the body to get the Coroner's report from Mal. He states the guy most likely died on impact, and when asked, states that a hood ornament could have caused the wound to the chest.

Now you get to take a look around the area. Examining the blood smear across the floor and the skid marks from the tires, you see that the car must have travelled at quite a speed, and did attempt to brake but couldn't. Neither of these adds anything to your evidence.
Down the alleyway to the left of Ray's Cafe, you'll see a dumpster with a smaller bin next to it. Head to the smaller bin and examine the knife that is inside, covered in blood.
That's it for now. Head to the witness standing outside the Cafe and trigger the interview.

blocks.title: Shannon Perry

topics.response: When asked for her statement, Perry says she looked out of her upstairs window because she heard an argument outside. This will give you the Argument Overheard clue, and if you believe her, she states that she saw the car hit the victim and knock him down the street. You'll also get a new topic to talk about.

When you ask about the car, she proudly states that it was a dark red Lincoln Continental. Again, no reason not to trust her, and by believing her, you also get the first three digits on the plate, 3C8.

When asked about the argument, Perry states she heard a man and a woman, and then goes silence. She looks a little shifty, but you have no evidence to prove her wrong so doubt her. She'll reveal that she wanted to sell her story to the papers! Even in the 40s you can't get away from Heat Magazine. She goes on to say that the two seemed to be married, and the woman attacked with some rather embarrassing comments.

paragraphs: After talking to Perry, head into the Cafe and speak to the bartender, who introduces himself as Dudley Lynch, who is covering for the owner who escorted the victim's wife home.

blocks.title: Dudley Lynch

topics.instruction: Hit and Run Incident: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks what Lynch knows about the incident. Lynch says that the bar was busy and he doesn't know much more than hearing the impact. He seems a little uncomfortable though, so select bad cop and he'll admit that Lester and Lorna (the wife) were having an ugly fight and he'd asked them to take it outside.

Phelps asks how well Lynch knew the victim, which was only as far as a regular at the bar. No reason to doubt him, so hit good cop, and he'll admit that he wasn't his favourite customer. He says Lester's wife Lorna accompanied him out that night, but "wasn't too interested in the booze"

topics.instruction: Argument Overheard in the bar: Bad Cop
topics.response: This topic only appears if correctly branching Shannon Perry's questions previously. When asking Lynch, he confirms that the argument was nasty, and aired some dirty laundry, but despite this statement being honest, he smirks as though hiding something. Select Bad Cop. and you'll find out about the bar owner, Leroy Sabo being very close to Lorna Pattison, and that the two were thinking of opening a bar together. This adds Lynch's statement to your clues, and you get the next topic for discussion.

When pressed for more about the bar, Lynch says that he just serves the drinks. He's got that smirk back again though, so doubt him again. Lynch starts to tell everything. Lester used to abuse his wife when under the influence, and also loved to gamble. Lorna pitched the bar idea to Sabo. However, he states that Ray's is barely making it, and he's no idea how the new venture would be funded.

paragraphs: Before you leave, pick up the third newspaper from the bar, and watch the cinematic. Afterwards, use the phone to call in the plate number for the car you're looking for. The only match for the car is registered to William Shelton, and gives you an address, which is where we're headed next.

blocks.title: Shelton Residence
paragraphs: Outside the Shelton residence is the red Continental, with Mr. Shelton loading suitcases into it. Shelton admits to the hit and run, and then speeds off in his Lincoln. Take control of your vehicle and take off after him. Try to ram his car off the road. To do this, aim for the tires with your rams, and you should soon get him. You can also let your partner attempt to shoot his tires if you can get alongside him long enough. If you don't apprehend him during this chase he gets out of his car and starts to run. You can apprehend him with a warning shot during this scene.
Shelton admits that he hit the man, but claims that the guy just jumped out in front of him. He also says that there was a man and a woman standing next to the victim.

blocks.title: Pattison Residence
paragraphs: At the Pattison residence, you speak to Lorna, who seems unfazed by the death of her husband. She is also joined by the bar owner, Leroy Sabo. The two explain the happenings of the previous day, and Lorna also says she was filing for divorce due to mental cruelty.

blocks.title: Lorna Pattison

topics.instruction: Hit and Run Incident: Bad Cop
topics.response: Lorna states that her husband walked out in front of the car. Her smirk suggests she's holding back, but you have no evidence, and you can only doubt her. When you do, she only says about his gambling addiction, and that she felt sorry for the driver.

When asked about the argument, she says that she was always arguing with her husband, and says "So what?" She's holding back again, so doubt her. Apparently Lester was losing at cards and made some inappropriate comments about how she could earn some quick money for him.

topics.instruction: Partnership with Leroy Sabo: Accuse - Insurance Letter
topics.response: Phelps asks how they were going to fund the venture, and she replies that she has some money stored away. She looks shifty, and you also know that she is in for a payoff from the insurance company for the death of her husband. Bring up the letter and the fact that she increased the premium and she states it was Sabo's idea due to the excessive lifestyle that her husband led. When Phelps tries to pin things on her wanting money quick, she points out that the evidence shows it was hit and run, which, unfortunately, it is.

paragraphs: Exit the house and use the gamewell on the street. You get the message that Mal wants to see you at Central Morgue, so head there now.

blocks.title: Central Morgue
paragraphs: Head for the autopsy room to trigger a cutscene. Lester was dead before the car hit him, probably from a wound inflicted with the bloody knife you found. Your hit and run case just became a premeditated murder case. I'm sure that will help your career. You know who you're going to pin this on, yeah?

blocks.title: Pattison Residence
paragraphs: Return to the Pattison residence to report the new findings to the wife. She immediately points the finger at Sabo, who comes out brandishing a gun. The scene ends badly, and you have to chase down Sabo.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Ford Deluxe Convertible
vehicleOpportunities.note: Parking lot beside Ray’s Cafe in “A Marriage Made In Heaven”

vehicleOpportunities.name: Ford Ambulance
vehicleOpportunities.note: Easiest is at the Coroner’s office during “A Match Made in Heaven”

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Capt. Gordon Leary, the head of the Traffic Desk, gives you the briefing for your case. A stolen green Kaiser Frazer is reported seen on 6 West Second Street, and its registration apparently is on the LAPD's hot sheet. A cop on his beat spotted it in the driveway, so you and Bekowsky are tasked to investigate.

blocks.title: 6 West Second Street

clues.name: Harrison's ownership papers (given during questioning of Harrison)

topics.instruction: Vehicle reported as stolen: Good Cop

topics.response: The car was bought legitimately from Coombs Automotive Co. for US$2,450. He bought it directly from Richard Coombs, the owner of Coombs Automotive Company, and Coombs made out the bill of sale personally, having the original copy at his office. He was in such a hurry because he had some weed stashed in the glove compartment, but you'll let it slide. After questioning is finished, you have an officer apprehend him for Grand Theft Auto and the possessions in the vehicle until the case is closed. You and your partner are then tasked to investigate Coombs Automotive Company.

paragraphs: When you get there, the car makes a run for it and you have to ram the vehicle to get it to stop. While chasing the car, you radio in for backup.
You stop the guy and ask why he was in such a hurry, and he said that he saw "two tough guys bearing down" on him and got scared. You then start to question him. Interview: Cliff Harrison

blocks.title: Coombs Automotive Company

topics.response: (WARNING: This question is missable if you don't turn over the back of the pink slip - Archer's ownership papers - when he gives it to you to examine)
Coombs bought the car from Jean Archer in a hurry and paid by cheque so he could back out if the sale proved bogus.

paragraphs: When you get to the auto lot, Richard Coombs, the owner, tries to sell you a Buick for your car. Ignoring his humour, and his offer, you proceed straight to questioning him in his office. Interview: Richard Coombs
Having been duped, you head back to the police station.

blocks.title: Central Police Station

clues.name: Note from Ray Pinker (given by Pinker)
Known associates of Archer (given during questioning of Archer)

topics.instruction: Association with Archer: Accuse - Archer's ownership papers
Association with Belasco: Accuse - Belasco's ownership papers
topics.response: Femme Imbécile Correctly branch every question in the interview with Jean Archer.

paragraphs: When you return to Central Station, Watch Cmdr. Mel Fleischer tells you he's in Interview Room Two, and says that this is "another stolen car with legit papers." Go in the room to begin the interrogation. He already is pissed at you, insulting you and saying his papers are legit. He also demands a lawyer. You look at the pink slip and claim it's a forgery, but it appears legitimate. Interview: James Belasco
After apprehending Archer, go to the Marquee Printing Company to speak with Gordon Leitvol.

blocks.title: Marquee Printing Company

topics.instruction: Knowledge of theft racket: Bad Cop

topics.response: According to Leitvol, this problem happened two years ago, where several used car lots were selling blank documents to a criminal organisation. While he doesn't recall Harrison or Belasco, he does remember Coombs, and he says they may have been involved in stolen documents in the past. When Phelps convinces Leitvol to show the Marquee Delivery Ledger, he notices that the one most frequently involved in placing orders comes from a "S. Bigelow" of 58 Industrial St., where the warehouse might be. Head there now.

paragraphs: Gordon's company is the only one that prints state vehicle titles. He suggests forgery when asked if any of his goods or equipment were stolen recently, and Phelps says the police will keep it in mind. He then begins to question him. Interview: Gordon Leitvol

blocks.title: 58 Industrial Street

clues.name: Box of pink Slips (on a table behind Bigelow)
Delivery note (on a table near Bekowsky)
Betting slips (on a table near Bekowsky, near the delivery note)

topics.instruction: Association with Leitvol: Accuse — Note from Ray Pinker
topics.response: Bigelow confirms that Leitvol supplied the pink slips and used the operation to cover his gambling debts.

topics.instruction: Deliveries to Industrial Street: Accuse — Betting slips
topics.response: Leitvol admits his betting problem and offers to cooperate, but Phelps arrests him for conspiracy and fraud.

paragraphs: Bekowsky thinks it is time to "bust open the warehouse" on 58 Industrial St. and as you enter, guns are drawn. There are eight people clustered in the back, two behind the gutted cars, and five others on the opposite side, one of them in the first window you see when you initially ask them to give up. Instead of going through the main door, go through the door Det. Bekowsky enters, and shoot the chain holding the hanging engine quickly, where it will drop on a flammable barrel and explode, killing a couple of people.

Up the stairs there are two more gunmen, watch your aim, use cover and take them out. After the gunmen are killed, one guy is in the office you storm in, Steven Bigelow, the warehouse operator. While Bekowsky watches him, you search his office for clues. The box of pink slips shows they have enough to keep stealing vehicles for a while.

The delivery note is directly coming from Levitol and his printing company, with horse betting slips made out by Levitol, where he doesn't appear to be winning. Phelps adds pressure on Bigelow, knowing he's involved in the operation of stolen cars and pink slips, but Bigelow just says he works on cars for "customers." The questioning begins. Interview: Steven Bigelow

cases.title: The Fallen Idol
objectives: Get Bishop off the Lot Alive

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: The case shows a rainy night, and you get to see a car parked on a hilltop. There is a man jamming something onto the floor, and then the car screeches into gear and flies off the embankment.

You're assigned to the case you were shown. Two women were in that car, and they both survived. The car hit a sign on the way down that stopped the full fall. One of the women is claiming that the incident was attempted murder. Finally, the best part is that the incident was right across the street from the police station.

blocks.title: Crash Site
paragraphs: You can walk across the street and up the stairs to the crash site. Approach the barrier to trigger a scene. Phelps recognises the woman in the ambulance, and Stefan explains that it is June Ballard, Hollywood B Movie actress. A uniformed officer tells Phelps that Ballard was the driver, and the passenger, a young girl named Jessica Hamilton, was taken to the hospital for her injuries.

Head down the trail past the police cars and you'll find the crashed car and Mal. He tells you to check the items laid out on the trunk. You can check the driver's door to see a bit of blood and a smashed window, but nothing of note.

On the trunk is two clues. A pair of Underwear that seems to have been ripped from the body. Mal said they were found in the purse. Open the purse to find the letter from mother, which begs Jessica to come home, and also mentions "Aunt Junie", Ballard perhaps?

Talk to Mal to receive the prop shrunken head clue. Examine it to get it added to your clues officially. Mal tells you that it was used to wedge the accelerator to the floor, showing that this is attempted murder.

blocks.title: June Ballard

topics.response: I'll say before we start, June Ballard does not tell the truth. She is an actress, and she seems to struggle being honest. Phelps asks who drugged her, and she claims she doesn't remember. Her acting career must be on the ropes, because she's not very good. Select Bad Cop, and she tries to flirt with Cole. It's not very effective. She finally reveals that her husband will sort out Mark Bishop, whoever he is. We'll ask about that in a minute.

When you ask about the girl in the car, June proves again that she won't be selected for the next blockbuster. She says its been such a rough day for Jessica. You have evidence to show its been more than rough for her. Select the Underwear to refute her lie and she suggests it happened during a casting session with Mark Bishop.

June explains that Bishop is a movie producer, and again mentions that her husband will take care of it. She's not lying, but she's definitely holding back. Select Bad Cop her and Phelps demands more. She claims that Bishop offered a part in a movie, and then went back on it. She pressed on the matter, and she says this is his response.

Phelps mentions the car was tampered with by a shrunken head. Ballard says the last thing she remembers is getting behind the wheel, but she's hiding something again. Select Bad Cop, and she again says to go to Mark Bishop, and suggests finding his prop company. She really has something against him.

paragraphs: After the less than revealing interview, you are advised by Bekowsky to go to see the passenger of the car. When you get into your vehicle, you get a call from KGPL saying that Hamilton has regained consciousness. Great timing!.

blocks.title: Central Receiving Hospital
paragraphs: Enter the hospital, and ask the lady behind the counter where you can find Jessica Hamilton. She's in the room across the hall. Approach the doctor outside, who tells you that the girl was drugged, and worse still there is clear evidence of abuse, which, when we consider that Jessica is 15, is more of a cause for concern. Enter the room.
Before you talk to Jessica, examine the clipboard on the bottom of the bed to update your Evidence of Abuse clue, then talk to her.

blocks.title: Jessica Hamilton

topics.response: Phelps asks about the crash, which she doesn't remember, but then blurts out that "nothing happened yesterday" and looks very uncomfortable. You know that something happened, so bring up the underwear and she admits to a liaison and some cold advice from June Ballard. Bekowsky's anger against Ballard is defended by Jessica though.

topics.instruction: Contact with Parents: Accuse - Letter from Mother
topics.response: Phelps says he needs to contact Jessica's parents. She says that the parents trust Aunt June to take care of her. You know that's not the case from the letter you read earlier, so bring it up and she tries to remember more about yesterday. She remembers going to a strange place with her aunt when she was slipped a Mickey Finn (knockout drops), and passed out.

When asked how she knows Bishop, Jessica reveals that her aunt is a big movie star, but elaborates no further. There is something more to this, so doubt her, and Phelps asks why Bishop wants her and Ballard dead. She admits to hearing some harsh and angry phone calls between Bishop and Ballard, but apparently the two had been on good terms recently.

topics.instruction: Evidence of Criminal Abuse: Good Cop
topics.response: Phelps tries to get information about the sexual abuse the girl has suffered. She says its hard to remember, which is understandable. Believe her, and Phelps coaxes a little bit of information out of her, a Mermaid on the front of the building.

paragraphs: As you leave the building, you spot June Ballard leaving the station with her lawyer. You decide that she's trying to leave too quickly for your liking, so you are to tail her.

You have to tail Ballard in your car to start with. Keep at a safe distance away from her, but don't let her get too far ahead or you'll risk losing her. Don't drive too recklessly, and don't have any accidents, or you will make the suspect suspicious. When you are close to failing the mission, the car indicator on your map will flash, you've failed if Ballard spots you, where you'll usually hear her question what you are doing before the fail screen comes up. If you leave it too long and the fail screen fully loads, quit out of the game and then hit resume on the main menu and you'll be able to try again.

So, the car we're following travels along 1st, turns right onto Spring, right onto 3rd, and then left onto Broadway. It then pulls up outside Mallory's Cafe, just before you reach 4th street. Assuming you haven't failed, you then have to tail her into the cafe and listen to who she speaks to. So, take cover on the right hand side of the door to Mallory's and move your camera so you can peek around the corner. Ballard is on the right hand side, by the phone, waiting for another man to finish his conversation. She is constantly looking around during this time, so stay in your cover. When the man hangs up, she goes to the phone, but continues looking around for a second. Wait until she picks up the phone. Then enter the cafe and walk to the empty booth on the left hand side. You'll be prompted to press A to go incognito, and as you do, Phelps will sit and hold a newspaper up to his face, concealing him from Ballard. Now all you need to do is Eavesdrop on the conversation.
She speaks to her husband, and demands action against Bishop, revealing Bishop's apartment address. After she says "Sure I got the film" she puts the phone down and leaves.

blocks.title: Mark Bishop's Apartment
paragraphs: As Phelps says, it sounds like Bishop's got some trouble coming his way. Get in your car and start to drive to Bishop's apartment. As you do, you get a Code 3 call (respond immediately, lights and sirens) saying that Bishop's apartment is being ransacked. Drive there as fast as you can, or make your partner drive. When you arrive, you have a small cutscene and then you can enter the building. The bellman says that Mrs. Bishop is pretty upset, and you can use the elevator to go to room 803.
If you drove to the apartment, not your partner (and got there fast enough), you'll get a quick opportunity to fight the thugs who were ransacking the place. Hold LT, and punch with A, dodge with X.

Gloria Bishop is obviously shaken up, so you get time to search the apartment. There is a lot of stuff in here that is irrelevant to the case, but 5 clues to find. Near the front door is a poster for a film called Gay Cowboys that isn't a clue, but the saddle across from it from the same movie is, and has the name Silver Screen Props on it (Remember Ballard suggested you find out where he gets the props from?)
Enter the bedroom by the entrance. On the floor near the wardrobe is the $20,000 check from Bishop to Lorna Hopgood, signs that Bishop is being blackmailed perhaps.

In the office 2 doors down, there is a movie set photograph and movie set replica on the table, showing the set for the Great Wall of Babylon movie set for the film Intolerance, which still exists downtown.

Enter the living room where Mrs. Bishop is sitting, and turn left to find a prop store photograph. The photo shows 2 men stood outside a store that has a mermaid on the front. This is without a doubt the place that Jessica remembered. Phelps asks about the men in the photo, and Gloria tells you that one is her husband Mark Bishop, and the other is the owner of the prop store, Marlon Hopgood.
The music stops when you find this clue, but you can step out onto the balcony to show the Babylon set mentioned earlier. When done, re-enter and speak to Mrs. Bishop.
So, providing you have 4 intuition points, which you should have by now, hit back on every question and use an intuition point to make a answer go away. Then choose the correct answer.

blocks.title: Gloria Bishop

topics.response: Gloria states that the thugs that attacked the apartment were probably Guy McAfee's men. She refers to Ballard as "that slut". She says that the recent things are to do with Bishop's latest movie, but claims to know nothing about it. Use your point, then hit bad cop, and she reveals that Bishop told Ballard that she wasn't in the movie repeatedly, and Ballard made several threats. She also says that she was in a film with Ballard once.

topics.instruction: Whereabouts of Mark Bishop: Good Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks where he can find Bishop, and she replies that he said he'd be on set, and that's all she knows. Use your point and then hit good cup. When Phelps says that McAfee's men are obviously after Bishop, she suggests asking Marlon Hopgood.

topics.instruction: Abuse of Jessica Hamilton: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps claims that Bishop was casting a young girl the previous day. Gloria denies knowledge of this, saying he was looking for a location as the picture was already cast. Again, use your point, then hit bad cop, and she says that her husband "likes them young" and that she was 16 herself when she met Bishop.

Phelps asks about the payment that Bishop is making to Lorna Hopgood. Gloria says that it is Marlon Bishop's Ex-wife, and asks if you are sure about the payment. She seems to know something though. Use your final intuition point, then hit Bad Cop, and you'll suggest that Bishop is being blackmailed. Whatever the blackmail is must be bad if he's attempting double murder to get out of it. The payment is going to Lorna Hopgood because she works at a check cashing service downtown.

paragraphs: After the interview, use the telephone to get an address for Silver Screen Props from R&I, then head back to your car and fast travel there.

blocks.title: Silver Screen Props
paragraphs: Enter the prop store to trigger a quick cutscene during which you meet Marlon Hopgood. You ask if he holds castings here, and he admits that he has a little soundstage out back. Follow Hopgood back to his stage.

Phelps decides to search the joint while Bekowsky keeps an eye on Hopgood. Walk up the small steps and head towards the chaise lounge, where you'll find the Chloral Hydrate on a nearby shelf. Then cross the room to the mirror to trigger a quick scene where Phelps discovers that it is a one way mirror, and behind it there is a camera that you can see. You gotta find that room.

Exit the soundstage and turn left to go through the door. You'll come out in a storage alley. Turn left and head for the workbench at the back, which has paint, buckets and a few shrunken heads. Look at the prop shrunken head molds to add them to your list. There is also another newspaper (#4) clipping on the bench, make sure you pick that up and check it out.

In the room you'll see the camera pointing through the mirror, and some dirty pictures on the walls. You'll find a film canister with Jessica Hamilton and Mark Bishop's names on it. Investigate it further to see that it's empty and add the clue.

Finally, you'll see the Jungle Drums Film Canister which can reveal Bishop's Whereabouts clue. He's using the Wall of Babylon set mentioned earlier. Music stops, so head back to Marlon Hopgood to start the interview.

blocks.title: Marlon Hopgood

topics.instruction: Association with Bishop: Accuse - Chloral Hydrate
topics.response: Phelps asks about Hopgood's association with Bishop. He claims that he provides for big film companies, and if Bishop is doing a big film, they cross paths. He claims that he hasn't seen him for a while. You know he's not telling the truth, you've got the Chloral Hydrate solution that you know was used on Jessica, so use it and Hopgood quickly spills the beans. He says that Bishop, Ballard and Hamilton were all here the day before.

Phelps explains that Guy McAfee is after Bishop, and Hopgood says that his advice to Bishop would have been to skip town if that was the case. Seems honest enough, so believe him, and he says that Bishop has had a number of goods delivered to the Jungle Drums set. He claims that the place is old and rundown but might be a good place to hide.

topics.instruction: Relationship with Ballard: Accuse - Empty Film Canister
topics.response: Phelps brings up the topic of Ballard. Hopgood claims that he rarely meets the talent. Use the Empty Film Canister as evidence, and Phelps outlines his theory that Hopgood and Ballard are working together to blackmail Bishop. Hopgood proclaims his innocence, but Phelps brings up the missing film reel of Bishop's "screen test" with Jessica. Hopgood admits to filming the liaison, and that Bishop's face was included at Ballard's request.

Phelps wonders why money is involved if Ballard has the blackmail material she needs. Hopgood denies all knowledge, but you know the Check exists. So bring up the check, and Marlon reveals that Ballard plans to sell the dodgy film of Bishop and Jessica after the next picture is finished. Lorna Hopgood works for a check-cashing service so she would be able to cash a check that large.

paragraphs: After you finish the last question, you get a visit from Roy Earle of Ad Vice, and he lets you know that Hopgood is a Vice informant. So you have to let him off the hook, and Earle advises you to go rescue Bishop.

Afterwards, Phelps and Bekowsky run into Guy McAfee's men, right outside the prop store. After the confrontation, a chase scene starts. You've got a couple of options. Firstly, you can carry on driving and either try to outrun them, or ram them off the road. Or you can pull over near an area where there is a bit of cover, get out and quickly take cover, then take them all out in a gun fight. I recommend the second one, as the chase itself can take a little bit of time, and if you've not really got the driving mechanics down, you can cause a hell of a lot of damage, which isn't worth losing your 5-star about. Plus, you can get your eye in for the rest of the mission.
When you've cleared up the goon squad, you have to go find Bishop at Jungle Drums Set.

blocks.title: Jungle Drums Set
paragraphs: When you arrive you immediately spot Bishop and he takes off. Chase after him through the old rickety set, and remember if he takes off round a corner, he's marked on your minimap as a red dot. You start climbing up loads of scaffolding, just stay on his tail and keep moving. Don't stop, Phelps will just jump over all the gaps you come across. There is a moment where he runs along and the entire path following him breaks away before you reach it. Take the left hand side during this part and you'll leap across some more gaps but stay with him. Eventually, Phelps will pull out his gun and you will automatically stop him. Before you can properly apprehend him, you see McAfee's men heading for the set. Bishop says he knows another way down to terra firma, so follow him.

You objective is to get Bishop off the set alive. In other words, kill everyone that isn't a police officer or Bishop. Follow Bishop until he stops and takes cover, whenever he does, it means there's people to kill nearby. I recommend you kill someone on your level so you can steal their weapon as soon as you can, as the rifles have a little more range on them than your ordinary pistol. Some of the gangsters are across the other side of the set, but they're easy to spot. When all gangsters in the area are dead, Bishop starts moving again, so stay with him.
While you're fighting your way through, look for red barrels (the staple explosive in video games) to shoot, which will explode and hopefully take out a few at a time.

Head down the ladder that Bishop leads you to and Bekowsky meets up with you. In the next area, there's a few barrels to explode and take out lots without too much trouble. Pick off the rest and head through the area towards your cars. When you get there, LAPD officers are engaging the rest of McAfee's men, so take out the remaining guys behind the cars and you'll complete the case.
After the shootout, your Captain will inform Phelps that he's been promoted to Homicide. Roy Earle will then take you to the Blue Room Jazz club for a drink.

cases.title: The Red Lipstick Murder
objectives: Investigate The Bamba Club and interview Dick McColl
Investigate Celine Henry's Residence and Canvass the Neighbours
Investigate Jacob Henry's Apartment and Interview/Subdue Jacob Henry
Go to Central Station and Interview Jacob Henry Again
Investigate Mendez's Apartment and Apprehend Mendez

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Its six months after the last case you played. You are introduced to the case by witnessing a well-dressed man pulling a girl from the back of a car, then bludgeoning her with a crowbar shaped object.

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: There are no clues are automatically rewarded for this case. Captain Donnelly announces the retirement of Floyd Rose, who you met in your first case. The replacement? Cole Phelps, teaming with Rusty Galloway, Floyd's old partner. Rusty's not particularly happy with this, but that's the way it goes. Rusty is an old school detective with old attitudes towards crime. If in doubt, blame the husband. Works in most cases, but it's not exactly evidence, so Cole will be trying to prove him wrong throughout your tenure together.

The crime is the one you just witnessed. You are given the location as a bit of park area called The Moors. Donnelly adds that the victim is "baring all the signs of the werewolf", alluding to the Black Dahlia killer who has been mentioned a few times. You'll be hearing a lot about this killer. Head to your brand new car and fast travel to the scene.

blocks.title: The Moors (Crime Scene)
paragraphs: On the way to the scene, Galloway will talk a little about the Dahlia murder. When you arrive, you'll trigger a quick scene with some reporters. Push past and you'll be briefed by Officer Houlihan. Approach the coroner to examine the body, and Carruthers also points out the victims belongings scattered about.

Examine the head first to get the Blunt Force Trauma clue, the likely cause of death. Then check out her left hand, which shows she is missing some jewelry, which has been torn from her finger. Complete the examination by looking at the body, which has writing on it, done in lipstick. The coroner says the writing may relate to the Dahlia, but he has no solid proof. He has no idea what Tex means.

Leave the body and look around the scene. At a marker you'll find Size 8 Shoe Prints, which an impression of has been taken to the station for testing. At another marker is the victim's handbag and brush. The brush is nothing, but inside the bag you'll find lipstick. Examine it closer to find out that it is not the lipstick used on the body, but appears brand new and unused. Strange. Finally, the last marker has a puzzle. Align the pieces of the globe so that the continents are correct and it will pop open. To make things quicker, work from the bottom up, as the base is fixed in place, it's not hard. When it opens, you find it is a lighter from the Bamba Club. The music stops, and Rusty suggests you go to the club for more details, so fast travel there.

blocks.title: The Bamba Club
paragraphs: Enter the club and chat to the guy behind the bar. He’s a temporary barman, but he does know the victim, and gives her name as Celine Henry. He directs you to Mr. McColl at the back of the room, saying that he knew Celine better. Head to the back of the room and approach the smartly dressed man on his own. The conversation triggers automatically. McColl seems stunned the Celine is dead, and says she was a regular in the club, and that he, Celine and her husband Jacob go way back.

blocks.title: Dick McColl

topics.instruction: Suspect seen with Victim: Good Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks if Celine was with anybody last night. McColl says that she started out alone, but attracted a lot of attention. One guy seemed very interested in her stories. He seems quite honest about everything, so believe him, and he goes on to say she left with the guy at around 11PM. McColl didn’t know the guy's name, but he did get the license plate of the car, which he hands over.

McColl knows Jacob Henry. He was a marine who married Celine after the war. He says that Jacob put up with a lot from his wife, and when asked if Jacob may have murdered his wife, he can’t give a completely honest ‘no’. Select Bad Cop and Phelps attempts to guilt trip McColl. It doesn’t work, and McColl says he tried to call Jacob a number of times to come get his wife as usual, but Henry refused. After 11.30, Henry stopped answering the phone. This adds Husband’s alibi to your clues.

topics.instruction: Ring Stolen from Victim: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks about the ring. McColl knows the one, says she’s had it since her flying days. When Phelps asks if Jacob bought the ring, McColl goes shifty, and vaguely says she got it before Jacob. I think you know who got her the ring, choose Bad Cop and he admits it was from him, and that he held a candle to her for many years.

paragraphs: Before you leave, Phelps gets an address for Celine, which is added to your locations. Set it as your destination, but don’t head there just yet. First, call in the number plate you were given from the phone at the front of the club. You’ll get the answer later on. Head to your car and travel to Celine Henry Residence.

blocks.title: Celine Henry Residence
paragraphs: Approach the front door. Nobody answers the knock, so Rusty heads around back. He discovers that the window has been jimmied, and kicks the back door down, before letting Phelps in the front.

Firstly, check the newspaper (#5) cinematic that you’ll find just inside the door for some more plot to do with Fontaine. Now you get the chance to search the house. There’s lots of booze around, Celine had a bad drinking problem, but that’s not case worthy. In the dining room, you find a female shoe, sized 9. Phelps notes that this is big for a lady.

Enter the kitchen and examine the window for signs of forced entry, which is added to your clues. Then find the important note on the fridge, which is from Jacob telling Celine the address to his new apartment when she sobers up. It also tells you his address and will add it to your locations. If you don’t find this, you cannot continue your investigations, so it's very important.

After the note, Phelps requests that Rusty calls tech services to come sweep the house, while you canvas the neighbors. However, before you do that, continue looking around the house. Head to the bedroom and check the vanity dresser to find an empty Tiffany box, which updates your missing jewelry clue. You also find a picture of Celine in her aviation gear, giving a thumbs up and showing the missing ring in all its glory. Now, time to go to the neighbors.

Exit via the back door and jump over the wall to the left. As you do, a car pulls up. Head on over, and the woman who gets out introduces herself as Jennifer Horgan, who has known Celine for over 10 years. She says that there was a loud fight last night at the Henry house. Apparently, Celine was drunk, and Jacob blacked her eye and left. Celine herself left at around 10PM. This gives you the Marital Problems clue.
You’re finished here, so collect Rusty and fast travel to Jacob’s apartment.
Jacob Henry’s Apartment.

Follow Galloway’s lead as he busts into the house and places Jacob under arrest. The guy seems very upset over his wife’s death, and it appears to be the first he has heard about it. Phelps sits him down and Rusty watches him while you scout the place.

Only two clues to find. Head to the bedroom and look in the open suitcase, which has some shoes inside. Examine one and discover it is size 11. That means Jacob may be off the hook, as the killer was an 8.

The second clue is the notepad on the counter between the kitchen and dining room. Use the pencil to shade in the page to reveal a note, which ominously asks someone to “do something about my wife”. That’s interesting.
Return to the living room to interview the man himself.

blocks.title: Jacob Henry

topics.instruction: Movements of Victim: Accuse - Bamba Club Lighter
topics.response: Phelps asks who could have killed Celine and where she went last night. Henry seems reluctant to answer, and vaguely says a bar. A husband with an alcoholic wife is bound to know where she goes through, and you certainly know where she was. Bring out the Bamba Club lighter, and Henry admits that the club called, but he refused to pick up his wife. He said when the phone rang again, he ignored it, which works with what McColl told you earlier. He seems devastated that his actions meant that Celine left with the killer.

topics.instruction: Last Contact with the Victim: Good Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks when Henry last saw his wife. He says they got into a fight last night, things got out of hand, and he left. This goes with what the neighbour said, and Jacob holds your gaze as he says it, so believe him. Phelps prods the time he left out of him, around 9PM, again, working with the neighbour’s story.

topics.instruction: Motive for Murder: Accuse - Death Threat Note
topics.response: This topic only appears if you have seen the note on the counter in the house before interviewing him. Phelps directly accuses Jacob of murder, and Henry denies by saying “I never gave up on my wife”. But he’s asking someone to do something, right? Use the Death Threat Note and Jacob says that he wanted to have Celine committed to a hospital for her drinking.

paragraphs: After the interview, Galloway proves his detective skills by pushing a little too hard and getting punched for his troubles. This starts a brawl between you and Henry. You have to subdue the enemy without getting your hat knocked off, which is usually one or two hits. Lock on with LT and use A to punch and X to dodge when you see something coming your way. It's not hard, but it might take some tries to get right. You’ll get plenty of chances throughout the game.

After the fight, you’ll have the chance to call Dispatch for messages. Use the phone near the notepad from earlier, and you’ll get the Coroner’s report saying that Celine was basically stomped to death. The wound on the head is also consistent with a socket wrench.

Next, you’ll be told that the plate number you asked to be traced earlier is a 1936 Pontiac belonging to Alonzo Mendez. His address is put into your locations, but before you can go there, the captain asks for all suspects to be returned to the station and questioned. You better listen to him.

blocks.title: Central Police Station
paragraphs: Donnelly wants a conviction of Henry to wrap this case up. Phelps thinks he’s not the man they’re after, but he goes into the interrogation room anyway.

blocks.title: Jacob Henry (Part 2)

topics.response: Phelps asks Jacob about the lipstick markings found on the victim’s body. Henry says he has no idea what he is talking about, and looks you dead in the eye, so believe him and you’ll get a “confession” about how Jacob was just a man who loved his wife.

topics.instruction: Deterioration of Marriage: Accuse - Marital Problems
topics.response: Phelps paints a picture to Henry about the previous evening, a marital fight that got out of hand. Jacob denies it, but you know there was a fight from the nosy neighbour. Bring up the marital problems, and Phelps insists that Henry was getting violent as the marriage got worse. He brings up the black eye, which Jacob admits to, be also claims that Celine was drunkenly swinging a frying pan, and he cracked after years of putting up with it.

topics.instruction: Access to Murder Weapon: Accuse - Husband’s Alibi
topics.response: Next you ask about Jacob’s work. He’s a mechanic for Hughes Aircraft Company. Phelps tells Henry that Celine was beaten with a socket wrench, and he’d have access to tools like that. Jacob replies that he was in bed. You have knowledge that he wasn’t exactly where he says he was, so use the Husband’s Alibi clue to say that McColl called him with no answer. Jacob lays out his marriage on a plate to Phelps.

Phelps now suggests that Jacob broke into Celine’s house and stole the woman’s Tiffany ring. Jacob plain states that he has a key, why would he need to break in? Good assertion Cole. You can’t argue with that one. Cole backtracks and says that Jacob stole the ring because he knew it was a gift from Dock McColl. Jacob is even more dumbfounded, and clearly had no idea of the origins of the ring.

paragraphs: After you’ve finished Donnelly appears very disappointed in the outcome. Phelps assures him that Mendez is their best lead now, but it doesn’t appease him. Head to Mendez’s apartment.

blocks.title: Mendez’s Residence

clues.name: Socket Wrench (Note: collecting the wrench triggers a cut scene so get this last)

paragraphs: You already know that Mendez lives in apartment 16. Checking the board outside, you see that 16 is on the 4th floor. Head straight upstairs to the end of the corridor on the 4th floor, and Phelps will automatically kick the door in.

Nobody is home, so do some investigating. Go down the hall to the bedroom to find a Size 8 Shoe on the floor. Then find the box that contains the other two clues, the Used lipstick (be sure to examine it further), and a bloody socket wrench. Looks pretty bad on the guy. (Note: collecting the wrench triggers a cut scene so get this last).

Speaking of which, Mendez gets home at that moment. Phelps informs him that he’s under arrest and he bolts. Follow him through the window and across the rooftops, then he slides down a ladder and a drainpipe to the ground. Just as Mendez is about the reach his car to escape, Rusty turns up in your car. Hop in the driver’s seat and give chase.

Follow Mendez and ram his wheels wherever possible. If you pull up on the left hand side of his vehicle, Rusty will attempt to shoot out his tyres, which is a good bet. Keep an eye on where you are going, as you don’t want to cause too much damage to property during this part of the chase, lest you lose your 5 star rating. When you disable his car, hop out and put the guy under arrest to close the case. If you fail to stop him, he crashes himself eventually, and you can arrest him then.
Afterwards, Donnelly seems much happier, toasts you, and you see Cole at the Blue Room jazz club enjoying the act. Case Closed
