blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: A call has come in that a drug addict is willing to spill the beans on a drug distribution ring in LA. Head over to Mike Lyman’s bar to get more information

blocks.title: Mike Lyman’s Bar
paragraphs: Head straight to the back to Freddie Calhoun. There’s no interview here, he just gives you information on Juan Garcia Cruz and his base of operations

blocks.title: Juan Garcia Cruz’s Residence
paragraphs: Juan opens fire on you in a cutscene to start this part off. From your start, use the fence as cover to go left and enter the neighbour’s yard. Walk down the yard to the back and hop back over the fence to the Cruz house.
Quick cutscene, then analysis of the building. Examine the body in front of you. This is Cruz, according to the wallet in his pocket. In his other pocket, you’ll find the Gunmen’s Silver Dollar clue.
Leave the body and turn around to find the notepad on the boxes behind you. Examine it to find the clue Masangkay, which makes no sense, but you need it.
To the right is the kitchen, with loads of cardboard boxes from Parnell’s Soup Company. Use the telephone to get an address for this.

Head out of the back door and go to the shed outside. Find the four cans together that you can investigate two of them. The one on the right will give you a surprise, and the one on the left will open a secret area.
Go to the desk next and find the ledger. With Juan dead, you need to find some sort of pattern in deliveries. Click on any line with E.J’s name on it, and you’ll get the clue Tijuana Dope Shipments
This is all the clues.
Now, quit and reload the game. You will be back at Cruz's Residence. If you don't do this, you will need to replay the case for the 5 star rating.
Now, head to Parnell's.

blocks.title: Parnell’s Soup Factory
paragraphs: Follow the receptionist up the stairs and into Mr. Parnell's room. Open the ledger and highlight Jorge Garcia Gruz.

topics.instruction: Factory Sealed Soup Cans: Bad Cop
Knowledge of Cruz Brothers: Bad Cop
Inside Man Jorge Garcia: Good Cop
topics.response: Follow Parnell through the factory until you can highlight 20th Century Market in the ledger.

blocks.title: Sergio Rojas

topics.instruction: Factory Sealed Soup Cans: Bad Cop
20th Century Market: Accuse - Sergio's or Juan's Silver Dollar
topics.response: Now head to the Market.

paragraphs: Inspect the silver dollar first.

blocks.title: 20th Century Market
paragraphs: Don’t be distracted though, as you’re in a chase. If you are quick, you can tackle him in a parking lot, if you weren’t fast enough then follow him up the ladder and win the ensuing brawl.
Afterwards, Cole convinces him to give up any drugs on him, and you get the clue Shopkeeper’s Silver Dollar, and then an interview.

blocks.title: Airto Sanchez

topics.instruction: Knowledge of E.J: Accuse - Airto's, Sergio's or Juan’s Silver Dollar
Juan and Jorge Cruz: Good Cop
topics.response: Now it back to the soup factory for a raid.

paragraphs: Choose a different gun out of the car if you want and head into the factory, killing bad guys. Careful for civilians.

Another cutscene, then afterwards, head for the body in the room in front of you and examine him. You get the Gunman’s Silver Dollar, and identify him as Juarez (this may change the name of the clue).
Go out into the main room and find Earle, who is stood by a box. Examine the box to find the clue Boxed Marijuana Shipment.
Another brief cutscene, then find your way upstairs to another body. This is Jorge, and he too has a clue, Jorge’s Silver Dollar. After this is another cutscene.
Let’s head to Masangkay Metals now to wrap this case up.

blocks.title: Masangkay Metals
paragraphs: Head for the back of the warehouse for another raid. Take out any hostiles as you work your way through the warehouse to the front, and then head up the stairs you find there, killing bad guys all the way.

blocks.title: American Legion Stadium
paragraphs: There isn’t a briefing for this particular case. This is a little more personal, especially if you are Roy Earle. Phelps and Earle are on a night out, attending a boxing match at the American Legion Stadium. Earle’s got 50 big ones on this fight, which he’s confident about, seeing as he knows that the fight it meant to be rigged. English boxer, Hammond is supposed to take a dive with some big money on the line, yet he knocks his opposition out before they even get close to where the fall should take place, and he takes off. Earle is understandably upset.
Open Hammond’s locker, which is the second one from the pin board, and check out the bookmaker’s odds that you find there. There is also a telephone number jotted on there.
Before you leave, there is a newspaper (#8) cinematic on one of the training tables which you should take a look at.

Exit the locker room and find Mickey Cohen, the local hotshot, putting heat on the manager. Cohen and Earle seem to know each other quite well, and Phelps demands that Cohen keeps his men away from Hammond.
Call KGPL using the phone down the hall, and get an address for the number you found. It is Hotel El Mar in Hollywood. Fast travel there now.

blocks.title: Hotel El Mar
paragraphs: Approach the desk to trigger a scene. He says he doesn’t have anyone in the establishment named Hammond, but it is not the sort of place where people use their real names. He lets you use the hotel register and Earle suggests you look for prominent Englishmen. That’ll probably be why Winston Churchill is apparently staying here then. Room 207 it is. Head upstairs and find 207.
Enter 207 and pick up the telegram from the bin that has been tipped over on the floor. It suggests that Hammond is on his way to England.

Inspect the dresser to find the movie ticket stub, and some chocolates in a heart shaped box, which shows that Hammond appears to have had a female companion. Then move to the table and examine the magazine. Examine closely, and have Phelps tap on the filled out coupon by a Candy Edwards, which adds the name to your POI.
Finally, on the nightstand next to the bed, there is a listing of the bookmaker’s payouts. Looks like Hammond stood to make a fortune betting on himself.
That’s it for this place; you’ll want to head to the Aleve Motel, which is the place that Candy Edwards listed as her address.

blocks.title: Aleve Motel
paragraphs: Enter the hotel and speak to the woman at the desk. She says that Candy is in room 7, and that a guy named Carlo was looking for her. Hammond’s manager seems to have beaten you to it. She directs you up the stairs outside. Leave the office and climb the stairs to apartment 7.
As you get closer, you hear Carlo shouting at someone. When you kick the door open, you see him punching a woman in the face. Knock him out!
After the fight, check his pockets to find a switchblade in one and a list of bookmakers in the other. The list is very similar to Hammond’s.

Go to the vanity dresser and look at the bus ticket, one-way to Ohio, as well as a card for the transoceanic ship, the Cunard Ascania, which sails from New York. Both will be added to your clues. At this point, the woman wakes up, and you get her to agree to be interviewed.

blocks.title: Candy Edwards

topics.instruction: Whereabouts of Hammond: Accuse - Magazine Coupon
topics.response: When Phelps asks where Hammond may be, Candy says their relationship was over and that she hasn’t seen him. You know that she must have been in his flat recently, so bring up the coupon. She admits she was there, but left him because he refused to throw the fight.

topics.instruction: List of Odds Recovered: Accuse - Bookmaker’s Odds
topics.response: Phelps asks about the names on the list, and Candy denies knowing them. Bring up the Bookmaker’s Odds, and she says that Hammond played dumb to fool them, and she’s amazed that he could “beat ‘em all”

topics.instruction: Plans to Leave Town: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks if Candy is leaving town. She says she is going straight home to Akron. It's pretty doubtful, so doubt her, but you still don’t get a real answer from her, despite this being right.

paragraphs: After the interview, Earle expresses that he’s shocked Candy isn’t running for the train station with all the men that are clearly going to be after her. He suggests she may be looking for a payoff, and says they should do a stakeout.

blocks.title: Tail Candy Edwards
paragraphs: The next morning, the detectives are parked outside Candy’s flat. She leaves her room carrying a large red bag, and starts walking. Phelps tails her, while Earle follows in the car.

You’ll have to complete the tail without using either cover or incognito, except for the incognito you start with right at the beginning of the tail. If you fail, you have to exit to menu and reload the save file, which will start you at the beginning of the questions you’ve just finished. It may take some doing, as the tail lasts a long time.

Firstly, stay in the first incognito spot until Candy goes in front of you and walks past the pale wall in the distance. Then, run down the street and hide behind the wall without going into cover. When she has gone past the lorry in front of you, use the lorry as a hiding spot, again, without going into cover. The key is to stand out of eyesight, behind something taller than you are, and you can’t be spotted. Trouble is, Candy has eyes like a hawk.

From the lorry, wait until Candy has got to the street. She looks around for a second, then heads to the right. When she starts walking again, move to the blue car in front of you. Wait until Candy is nearly at the next street and Cole will say something about losing the trail. Move a little up the fence in front of you, until a tree is covering you, then hop over and use the tree to hide. A lorry of some sort will come from the right hand side down the road Candy has just crossed. Run to it and hide behind the tall part. It's difficult to see Candy at this point, as you’re letting her get quite far ahead.

Wait as long as you can, until the lorry pulls off and then run for the building ahead, to the right of Candy. Make sure to move to the right as you run, so that you cover yourself as you run to the building.

Wait for Candy to reach the road and take a right. Cole will say something about being too far away again, and you can move to the corner of the building you’re currently behind, using the pillar as cover. You’ll be stood by an incognito spot, but don’t go incognito

Wait again until Candy is going behind the tree and pillar in front of you, and Cole speaks again. Head for the pillar and you’ll reach it just as Candy disappears behind the buildings. Now run for the building.

Candy heads for the street in front of you, and starts to head left across the main road. Use the thick tree in front of you, and the car just beyond that, then carefully cross the road, using the red house to cover you.

Cole next speaks when Candy starts to take a left, past the houses. Use the car parked in the drive of the house you just hid behind, then when she’s gone safely past, arch around to the right and hide behind the dumpsters that she just took a left at, so you’re behind her again.

Wait until she has nearly crossed the car park, and then run to the second set of dumpsters on the right. Candy starts to head to the right, but stops and looks around before she passes the houses, so make sure you are nicely covered by the dumpster before. She then heads past the white house, so use it and run to the corner to see her again.

Wait until she has gone a bit past the small white outhouse looking thing in front of you, and then make it behind that. Candy heads for the alleyway on the left of your screen, so wait until she’s heading down there and follow her, staying behind the right hand building.

blocks.title: Thrifty Liquor
paragraphs: Exit your car and head for Thrifty Liquor, which Candy just went into. Enter the store to reveal the place has no liquor whatsoever, but a bookmaker’s business. The shop is run by Harry, who was on your list of bookie’s that you found in Hammond’s locker. Harry says that Candy cleared him out of $3,600 dollars of winnings, then left through the back door. But she did use the phone and wrote on a notepad before leaving.
Go to the phone and do the pencil shading trick to reveal your next location, Examiner Drugstore, with an address. Head there next.

blocks.title: Examiner Drugstore
paragraphs: On the way to the next place, you get a call from KGPL with a list of bookmakers that are operating out of shop fronts in Hollywood. You know about the first two, but they also give you Mac’s Spirits, which gets added to your locations as Ray’s Bookmaker’s.

When you reach the store, enter and speak to Mervin, the second name on the list, and he says that Candy took $4,000 off him before calling a cab and leaving. He gives you a card from which Candy got the number for the cab from. Use the phone to call it in and get the number of the cab that was dispatch to Candy, number 179.
Mervin confirms that Ray runs a bookie’s at Mac’s Spirits, and it's likely that it's going to be Candy’s next destination. Head there next.

blocks.title: Ray’s Bookmaker’s
paragraphs: When you reach the bookie’s, you trigger a scene. Cab 179 is parked out front waiting. You decide to tail the cab. Candy soon leaves the bookmakers, and gets into the taxi.

Drive very carefully, and follow at a safe distance, to avoid being caught. The cab takes a really long winded route through the city to reach its destination, but you can keep tabs on it using your radar if you lose it around a corner. Finally, it arrives at Interstate Bus Depot, a few blocks away from Ray’s Bookmakers!

blocks.title: Interstate Bus Depot
paragraphs: When you enter the depot, Earle spots Hammond, and starts to tail him. You have to tail Candy once more. Don’t worry, this is much easier. Go to the bench in front of you and go incognito. Wait until Candy enters the ladies restroom, and then follow her. As you get near, you hear a gunshot and Candy screams.
Get inside and find Candy. The red suitcase is gone. When Earle turns up, he points the finger at Hammond (weren’t you following him Earle?), but Phelps isn’t so sure.

Search the scene. You’ll find a revolver on the ground. Then pick up Candy’s purse and examine it to find a movie ticket. You’ve not really got anymore leads, so the address for the theatre is added to your locations, and your next job is to visit there.

blocks.title: Egyptian Theatre
paragraphs: On the way to the theatre, you get a call from the coroner. It appears that the gun belonged to Candy herself, and she wasn’t killed by a gunshot, but a knife wound. Everything seems to point towards Carlo now. Head into the theatre to hear the voices of Hammond and Carlo. Listen to the conversation, then Carlo takes a few wild shots at Hammond.

Phelps and Earle head into the action and you have a gun fight with Carlo and his men. Shoot at Carlo until he runs from the high box, and then take out the goons who appear through the front of the theatre, being careful of the guy with the Tommy Gun. Take out the guys in the box on the right as well, and then when Carlo enters the main room, nail him with a few shots to drop him and finish the case.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Buick Custom
vehicleOpportunities.note: In the Boxing Stadium car park during “The Set Up”

vehicleOpportunities.name: Lincoln Continental Coupe
vehicleOpportunities.note: Parked on the curb as you leave the bookies in “The Set Up”

vehicleOpportunities.name: Pontiac Torpedo Six
vehicleOpportunities.note: Parking lot behind Maldonado residence in “The Silk Stocking Murder”, or Boxing stadium car park in “The Set Up”

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Homicide involving army surplus morphine has come up, and you’ve been asked to help out your old pals Galloway and newly promoted Bekowsky. Morphine is automatically added to your clues list.
Head over to the Crime Scene.

blocks.title: Crime Scene
paragraphs: You’re heading for apartment six, which is upstairs. When you get there, you’ll get a cutscene, then the chance to examine the body, you get information by examining the head and right arm, but the left arm gives you the Black Sapphire Ring clue. Then the cutscene continues, and you get the Two Suspects clue.

Examine the apartment. Head out of the bathroom and into the second room, and find the jacket hanging on the wall for the Men’s Smoking Jacket clue. Examine the pills by the bed on the floor, which don’t give you a clue, then look at the Sleeping Pills on the bedside table. Examine closer for the Benzedrine Prescription.
Go back through the hallway and into the living room. On the cabinet is three pictures, examine the middle one for the Modelling Job clue. Investigate further for your next objective.
Now head back upstairs to question the victim’s maid.

topics.instruction: Victim’s state of mind: Accuse – Sleeping Pills
Victim’s Personal Life: Accuse – Men’s Smoking Jacket
topics.response: This gives you the clue Housekeeper’s Statement.

blocks.title: Dr Stoneman’s Practice
paragraphs: Enter the doors and find Stoneman’s office, which is room 505, up the lift to the fifth floor, at the end of the hall. After a couple of cutscenes, interview the doctor.

topics.instruction: Relationship With Victim: Accuse– Benzedrine Prescription

blocks.title: D’Assine Dress Store
paragraphs: Talk to the woman behind the counter to find out she is the owner. Introductions over, let’s start the interview.

topics.response: Afterwards, you’ll be introduced to the victim’s friend, Heather Swanson. Cole asks to examine her Pearl Engagement Ring. Then the interview starts.

When the interview is over, he asks Heather if she can get her fiancé to visit the police station for questioning, and tells her the fate of Julia. Now head outside and use the phone. The coroner wishes to see you. Head to the Central Receiving Hospital, otherwise known as the Morgue

blocks.title: Central Receiving Hospital
paragraphs: Find the morgue, and listen to Carruther’s autopsy, which gives you the clue. He also asks you to look at something, so go and examine the harmonica, but it doesn’t give you a clue. You are told that Henry Arnett is in interview room two in the station across the parking lot.
Head over to interview room two and speak to Arnett.

blocks.title: Tail Henry Arnett
paragraphs: Before attempting this, remember, that you have to never be spotted. You will have to quit the game and reload the case in order to reset the chance of getting it. Tailing Arnett without being spotted is very difficult, especially when you have to go on foot. Oh, and you’ll have to redo Arnett’s interview again if you fail. Talk about added incentive.

The car part is easy. Just don’t crash into the traffic around you, despite the fact there seems to be absolutely loads, and keep your distance, while keeping him in your sights. Eventually, he will pull over at the side of the street, and you stop behind him. Then you have to tail him on foot.

Now it gets tricky. Quickly locate him using B, he’s across the street from you, wearing blue. Don’t cross over to him, stay on the side where your car is parked. Use the palm trees to be sneaky, block yourself from his view, and make your way up to the newspaper stand thing, and go incognito. He can’t spot you like this, so wait until he crosses to your side of the road, and starts to walk away from you, then leave the cover.

As you cross the road in front of you, hang towards the right a little so that if he turns around, you’ve got a building in the way (he will turn around, so if you don’t, you’ll be spotted here). Hide behind the building until he turns right down an alleyway, then run towards it. He’s gone down the second alley, not the first, so don’t pick the wrong one. It’s after the blue building.
In the cutscene, you’ll get both clues, Train Ticket and Fabergé Cigarette Case
Now use the telephone to continue the case.

blocks.title: Hollywood Ninth Beat
paragraphs: You immediately have to chase some bad guys. Follow them until the construction yard then gun them down.
After this, there’s a cut scene, and then you are to return to Hollywood Police Station

blocks.title: Hollywood Police Station
paragraphs: Officer gives you the clue. Examine the Pearl Ring, Black Sapphire Ring, Fabergé Cigarette Case and Silver Pill Box on the list, then leave and head for Mrs. Evestrom’s residence

topics.instruction: List of Stolen Items: Accuse – Fabergé Cigarette Case

topics.response: After this, there will be another cutscene, and you’ll have to drive Heather Swanson to Arnett’s Apartment. If you turn on your police sirens, cars will move out of the way thus becoming easier.

blocks.title: Arnett’s Apartment

topics.instruction: Professional Burglary Ring: Accuse – Fabergé Cigarette Case
Motive for Randal Murder: Accuse– Train Ticket
Identity of “Mr Henderson”: Accuse – Contraband List

paragraphs: When you get to Arnett’s Apartment, you’ll find Arnett on the floor and somebody escaping. Chase him as far as you can and you’ll activate a cutscene. You’ll then find yourself back at Arnett’s apartment.
On the floor in front of you is a suitcase, which contains a train ticket and the watch clue. Now question Arnett.

blocks.title: Dr Stoneman’s Practice
paragraphs: Stoneman has a lot to say, so listen to the cutscene. Afterwards, use the phone on his desk.

blocks.title: Willy’s Apartment
paragraphs: Yet another cutscene. Afterwards you have to find Willy. Find the intersection of Vine and Hollywood. Go north up Vine ST. and take a left at "Hollywood BLVD.". You know you are right when you hear the music of a harmonica. Keep following the music until you trigger a cutscene.
Chase him on the roof. When you get all the way to the top, Willy starts to climb the tower in front of you, and it's your chance to take him out.

cases.title: Manifest Destiny
objectives: Investigate the 111 Club Shootings and Interview Hostess
Travel to The Blue Room and Interview Elsa Lichtmann
Interview Mickey Cohen at the Mocambo Club
Talk to Detective Caldwell at Hollywood Station
Travel to Kelso’s Apartment and Interview Kelso
Travel to Robert’s Diner and Chase Gunmen
Travel to Chinese Theatre and Chase Gunmen
Travel to Alleyway Meeting and Eliminate Cohen’s Goons
Return to Hollywood Station and Interview Courtney Sheldon

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Phelps and Earle get the task of investigating a double shooting at the 111 club. When they point out that it sounds like a homicide case, it is revealed that the victims had a lot of army surplus morphine on the go. There was also a judge who was recently found dead from the powerful stuff, and it is clearly still on the streets, despite your capture of Lenny the Fink.

blocks.title: 111 Club (Crime Scene)
paragraphs: Homicide is already there, including your old pal from Traffic, Stefan Bekowsky. Phelps learns that the dead club owner is a former member of his marines' squad, Eddie McGoldrick. Stefan tells you that the other victims are musicians, Bowe and Bittleston, who were once in a band with Tyree and Lamont from The Black Caesar case. Strange how this is all linking up.
Right, first, let's start with Bowe, who is the body leant against the bar at a marker. Phelps notes that numerous rounds have been pumped into him.

By another evidence marker is an instrument case. Open the case to see a trumpet, and 3 trumpet keys. Examine each of the keys to lift them out of the case and put them back, and when you’ve looked at all 3, a compartment opens. Inside you’ll find a Blue Room Pass and a syringe, which updates your morphine clue.
Next, head to the body of Bittleston. Examine his right pocket to find another syrette, and another update to your morphine clue.

Just beyond Bittleston’s body is an open door. Walk through it and examine the crate with huge amounts of Valor Cigarettes. Near to the crate is a gun rack holding 3 military rifles, BARs. Phelps notes the guns look like they’ve never been fired. He also says that the morphine, guns and cigarettes are all army surplus. Earle suggests that the two of them look into the Coolridge Heist, to see what items were stolen.
You’ve found all the clues in the area. To be thorough, you can go into the back room to find Eddie McGoldrick, and a safe holding money. Robbery was not the intention behind this murder.
Head back to the bar to interview the hostess.

blocks.title: The Hostess

topics.response: Phelps asks who might have done the shooting, and she replies that she has no idea. She seems a little shifty though, so doubt her, and she points out that ever since buying the club, Eddie had visitors from mobsters.

Phelps asks about Eddie. She says that he knew nothing about running a club, but he came into some money and bought the place recently. Believe her, and Phelps asks where he got the money. She suggests that he was selling something that may have been illegal.

paragraphs: Next job, you’ll want to head to the Blue Room.

blocks.title: The Blue Room
paragraphs: Enter the club to trigger a scene, which automatically brings up the next interview, with Elsa Lichtmann, who you’ve seen a number of times.

blocks.title: Elsa Lichtmann

topics.response: Phelps points out to Elsa that there have been a growing number of overdose cases, and asks for any information she may have. She says nothing, but given that she recently knew the victims, that’s hard to believe. Doubt her, and Phelps loses his patience, which in turn increases the ire of the band, who simply states they have nothing to do with it. “White man sells, Black man buys”

Elsa says she knows nothing of the new victims, but clearly knows more than she is telling. Doubt her, and she says that she knew the horn player, Cornell, and says he wasn’t very good. The band point out that he was “a sad lonely cat”.

paragraphs: This ends the interview, but Elsa sends the band away so she can talk to Phelps privately. She asks Phelps why he is fighting a battle he isn’t going to win. She also asks why they’re asking Elsa and not the main dealer in LA, Mickey Cohen. Earle actually agrees with her, and suggests they head to Cohen’s usual haunt, the Mocambo Club. Phelps asks to leave it until morning, so he can check a few things out first.

blocks.title: Tail Elsa Lichtmann
paragraphs: Later in the night, you have to tail Lichtmann. It’s a standard car tail, stay well back from her, but not too far that you lose track of her. She’s fairly easy to spot in the bright yellow taxi in the dark. When you reach the apartment, there is a cutscene, and you’ll skip to the next day.

blocks.title: The Mocambo Club
paragraphs: Enter the Mocambo club and be led to Cohen. After the 3 men, plus Cohen’s enforcer exchange pleasantries, the interview begins.

topics.response: Phelps asks about Cohen’s brother in law, Lenny the Fink, and the recovery of a third of the stolen morphine shipment. Cohen states he knows nothing about it. He’s a major crime boss, and knows how to deal with the cops, so his misdirection could easily be seen as truthfulness. However, he didn’t get to being a crime boss by being honest, so doubt him, and Phelps says he finds it hard to believe that he knows nothing about where Lenny got the shipment. He gets a rather blunt answer though, Cohen won’t crack.

Phelps mentions that it was a group of marines who are suspected of the Coolridge Heist, and there is a link between that, and the fact that one of the marines is now dead. Again, Cohen coolly answers that he doesn’t know. Doubt him, and he says that dope isn’t his thing, but he’ll keep an ear out. Yeah, of course. The detectives leave, and we’re treated to a conversation between Cohen and his enforcer. The case picks up back at the station.

blocks.title: Hollywood Station
paragraphs: Hollywood station is a press central once more. Earle describes the latest political wrangling, and the detectives visit Lieutenant Colmyer to ask who is on the Coolridge Case. He points you to Burglary/Robbery squad room to speak to Detective Caldwell. Follow Earle.

Your entrance triggers a scene, with Caldwell reporting that the heist was an inside job, and also lists some of the stolen objects, including BARs and Valors, which sounds familiar. He then hands over the manifest listings for you to look at.
Tap your finger on the Thompson Submachine Guns (3rd from top), Browning Automatics (5th), Valor Cigarettes and Morphine listings.

Before you get the chance to discuss this, an officer rushes in saying there has been an attack on a city bus by a shooter with an automatic rifle. KGPL is calling all units to the scene. Hurry to your vehicle.

blocks.title: Bus Shooting
paragraphs: Your arrival on the scene triggers a cutscene. The gunman’s firepower is a million times more than the cops currently at the scene. The only option is for someone to get closer.
From your start position, head left, away from the scene, and turn down the first alleyway on your right. There should be a truck here.

NOTE: This truck is the easiest way to get one of the most annoying vehicles in the game, the International KB5. Hop in and out of it as you pass and it will save you playing this mission again later to get it.
Continue past the truck and down the alley. Head around the next corner and find the fire escape ladder. Climb up to the roof.
You emerge behind a stairwell exit, which is covering you from being gunned down. Take cover at the left of the structure and take out the gunman across the building from you.

Once this is done, head over to the sniper’s fallen body and examine his gun. You’ll discover that it is one of the stolen BARs. Search his body, and you’ll find the sniper’s pocketbook. It lists a table number and phone number at the Mocambo Club.
After finding this, another scene will trigger and Phelps recognises the bus driver, Felix, another soldier from the sixth marines. Time to interview him.

blocks.title: Felix Alvarro

topics.instruction: Informed of Coolridge Heist: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps asks about the Coolridge. Felix admits that the police questioned him, but says nothing more. There must be more to it however, so doubt him, and Phelps tries to scare him by telling him of Eddie’s fate. Felix merely says that he heard Eddie had come into some money, and that the victim should have kept a low profile.

topics.instruction: Motive for Shooting: Accuse - Sniper’s Pocketbook
topics.response: Phelps asks directly who was shooting at Felix, to which he replies that he doesn’t know. The sniper clearly knows him though, so use the sniper’s pocketbook against Felix, and he admits that Mickey Cohen seems to think that the members of the 6th marines stole the morphine because they were on the ship. He says that Courtney Sheldon is meeting with Cohen to sort it out, and that Jack Kelso is also in LA.

paragraphs: Head to the nearby game well and ask for Kelso’s address, then head there next.

blocks.title: Jack Kelso’s Apartment
paragraphs: Short visit to Kelso’s apartment. On the way, Phelps praises Kelso and says he won’t be involved in the morphine. When you arrive, Kelso turns up just after you. He agrees to talk, but Phelps says that it has to be at the station, which Earle agrees with. The trip to the station happens automatically.

blocks.title: Hollywood Police Station
paragraphs: The interview session begins immediately.

blocks.title: Jack Kelso

topics.response: Phelps brings up the gang war over the morphine. Kelso says it has nothing to do with him, and while you have no proof that Kelso is involved, but he was on the Coolridge, so you know there must be something he knows. Doubt him, and Earle points out the fact, but Kelso proves that he’s a tough customer and gets out of talking.
Phelps asks if Kelso had heard about Eddie’s windfall and purchase of the club. Jack answers honestly, so believe him and he admits he had not heard about the shooting and appears sad by the news.

topics.instruction: Arms Stolen From Coolridge: Good Cop
topics.response: Kelso claims that he has no knowledge of the stolen crate of BARs, and holds your gaze. Believe him, and Phelps informs him about the bus shooting, and implores him to talk or innocent people may be hurt. Kelso turns it around on Phelps and brings up some of Phelps’ past with the marines.

Phelps asks directly what Kelso knows about the robbery. Kelso deflects the question, so doubt him, and both Phelps and Kelso exchange words, showing they have nothing but bad blood between them. Earle sticks his oar in too.

paragraphs: Earle allows Kelso to go, but as you finish, another cop bursts in and informs you of another shooting victim, former marine Chris Majewski. Head to the new location, Robert’s Diner

blocks.title: Robert’s Diner
paragraphs: On your arrival, a young man rushes out and points out the shooters. They’re taking off in a green Packard. Follow them, taking care not to cause too much damage. You cannot actually pull the car over until it reaches the destination, so just stay on its tail until they reach an alleyway, which they turn down and pull out their guns.

blocks.title: Alleyway Crime Scene
paragraphs: Gun down both of the men to trigger a scene. Phelps and Earle approach the first body to search it (you cannot search the other body). Check the man’s right pocket to obtain the shooter’s notebook, which contains a note about a 9PM meeting with Courtney Sheldon and Mickey Cohen. Courtney gets added to your notebook.

In his left pocket, you’ll find a copy of the manifest you saw earlier. It has been heavily annotated, with circles around some of the names and the names of the dead men crossed off. It looks like Driscoll, Beckett are next at the post office, and Higgins and Connolly at the Chinese Theatre. All the names and locations are added to your book.
Before you leave, there is the ninth newspaper near the body of the first shooter.
Now we’re going to head to the post office first.

blocks.title: Hollywood Post Office
paragraphs: You arrive in the middle of a gunfight. Use the parked cars for cover and shoot the guys in the post office. There are quite a few guys to take out, so check all the windows and doors and make sure you don’t miss any.

After taking out the shooters, you’ll be in the post office near one of the victims, Beckett, another former marine. Approach him to find out he is still alive, and has some final words. “Tell Courtney bad luck, it was worth a try”. In his left hand there is a business card for Lenny Finkelstein and the Polar Bear Ice Company that you have already busted.

The other victim is in the alcove of the postal boxes. Search his left pocket to find a note which lists the address of where the Sheldon/Cohen meeting will take place. It appears that Sheldon was bringing his own team of former squad mates as back up.
Next, let's check on the other two guys on the manifest, at the theatre.

blocks.title: Grauman’s Chinese Theatre
paragraphs: As you arrive, you see Higgins and Connolly walk away from the theatre entrance. A red car pulls up and a masked man guns down the two of them, before taking off. Phelps and Earle head off in pursuit.

Same as usual, stay on the tail of the car as it zigzags through the streets. You can actually take this one out, so do so as soon as you can, either by shooting out its tires or ramming them off the road.
When you do so, take out the masked gunman before he gets chance to open up on you with that Tommy Gun. Next, we’d best check out the meeting between Sheldon and Cohen.

blocks.title: Meeting Place
paragraphs: You arrival causes Cohen to escape in a car while his goons stop behind to take you on. Gun down the men, watching out for the gunman on the roof to the right. Then continue down the alleyway, taking out more gunmen as you go. Fight your way down the alleyway, using the dumpsters for cover. Alternately, climb a drainpipe and take them out from the rooftops. When the last guy falls, Earle takes a call from KGPL saying that Courtney Sheldon is at Hollywood Police Station.

blocks.title: Hollywood Police Station
paragraphs: Phelps is told he is to take this interview on his own. Enter Interview Room 2 to find Sheldon with Dr Harlan Fontaine.

blocks.title: Courtney Sheldon

topics.response: Phelps mentions all of the marines that have been killed. Sheldon says that he cannot be blamed for their deaths. However, you have something that suggests that he can. Bring up the note, and Sheldon insists he has nothing to do with the morphine. Fontaine says he believes him.

topics.instruction: SS Coolridge Robbery: Accuse - Beckett’s Confession
topics.response: Phelps points out that Sheldon was on the Coolridge and had the opportunity, but Sheldon continues to deny it, saying “it doesn’t mean I was involved” Beckett seemed to think otherwise though, before he died. Bring it up, and Sheldon expresses sorrow for the former marines, but says their actions can’t be pinned on him. Phelps says he will be going after Kelso next, and Sheldon defends Kelso. He finishes by asking what kind of deal Phelps can offer.

paragraphs: Before the two can come to any sort of agreement however, the door bursts open and Captain Donnelly enters. He sends Phelps up to the chief’s office.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Buick Eight Convertible
vehicleOpportunities.note: Parked to the right of the Central Gun Shop during “Upon Reflection”, or by Kelso’s apartment in “A Polite Invitation”, or opposite the shootout alley in “Manifest Destiny”

vehicleOpportunities.name: Packard Clipper Eight
vehicleOpportunities.note: The fleeing suspects drive this in Manifest Destiny. After the shootout, climb in their wrecked car

vehicleOpportunities.name: Cadillac Series 61 Touring Sedan
vehicleOpportunities.note: When you have to sneak around the building in “Manifest Destiny”, you can find this in the parking lot round back

vehicleOpportunities.name: Chevrolet Civilian Van
vehicleOpportunities.note: Gas station across the street from the fire station in “Manifest Destiny”

vehicleOpportunities.name: American La France Fire Truck
vehicleOpportunities.note: at the start of “Manifest Destiny”, leave the Vice Precinct and the fire station is directly opposite

vehicleOpportunities.name: International KB5
vehicleOpportunities.note: Best place for this is in “Manifest Destiny”. When the sniper is shooting you, sneak around to the alley on the left (behind you when you start), and the truck will be waiting for you there.

weaponOpportunities.name: Chicago Piano Gun
weaponOpportunities.note: The free DLC places one in your car boot. Without it, the Manifest Destiny alley shootout can yield one; take down the automatic-weapon enemy first.

weaponOpportunities.name: BAR
weaponOpportunities.note: Available in Manifest Destiny, A Polite Invitation and A Different Kind of War.

cases.title: The Gas Man
objectives: Investigate Steffens Fire and Interview Don Steffens
Investigate Gulliver’s Travel Agency and Interview John Cunningham
Complete Lynch’s Gas Puzzle at Fire Station
Go to Clemens’s Worksite and Interview Clemens
Go to Ryan’s Worksite and Apprehend Ryan
Go to Varley’s Worksite and Apprehend Varley
Interview Varley and Ryan at Wilshire Station

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: The case begins with a fairly innocent scene. Repair work is being done on a heater system. A man works on an InstaHeat gas water heater box. He flips something, and then screws the top back on.
The next day, Phelps is introduced to the desk, and partnered up with Herschel Biggs, a veteran of the desk. Their first assignment together is two house fires, possibly suspicious.
Travel to the Steffens House Fire first.

blocks.title: Steffens House Fire
paragraphs: Nothing is left at the site but a bunch of smouldering ruins. Biggs points out that the fire was not started as an insurance scam like some cases, as you can see the ‘Real hurt’ in the owners eyes. In fact, the officer on the scene reports that the family have no insurance, and the fire occurred last night while they were on a vacation that they had won.
Start with the interview of the home owner, Don Steffens.

blocks.title: Don Steffens

topics.response: Steffens says that the prize was a weekend on Catalina Island. The flyer came from a group called the Suburban Redevelopment fund, which adds another clue and question to ask. Believe him, and he says his wife simply filled out the flyer and sent it in. They got a call from a woman saying that they had won.

Steffens says the group is buying out homes in the neighbourhood. Most of his neighbours just took the cash offered and moved. He claims he never bargained with the group, but looks a bit shifty. Doubt him, and he says that he was holding out for a higher price than the others as he owns the centre lot. He then admits that he’ll have to take the offered price now.

paragraphs: Talk to Don and he hands over the competition ticket for the prize trip that he won. They were issued at Gulliver’s Travel Agency, and the location is added to your notebook.

After this, search the site for clues. There’s not a lot to go on. Go around the opposite side of the house and find the InstaHeat water heater unit on the ground. The heater was recently serviced by Matthew Ryan, which adds the clue to your notebook, and Ryan to your POI list.

Before you leave, head to the nearest game well. Call in for information and find out an address for the Suburban Redevelopment Fund. It is both privately funded and government backed plan to build new homes for G.Is. You’re also given an address. Now head for Gulliver’s Travel Agency

blocks.title: Gulliver’s Travel Agency
paragraphs: Enter the agency and chat to John Cunningham, who finds the Steffens entry in a ledger, and lets you take a look. Tap on the Steffens entry, and also the Sawyer entry before backing out of the examination.

topics.response: Cunningham says the Redevelopment fund runs the travel promotion, and the list covers half of Los Angeles. Believe him, and Phelps asks if the fund is a government agency. Cunningham chuckles and says that the government doesn’t get involved with things like this.

Phelps asks about the prizes, the man gets rather nervous. He says the lucky winners had their names pulled out of a hat, but doesn’t look convinced. Doubt him, and Phelps brings up the “unlucky” Steffens family. Cunningham admits that he gets a call every week from Suburban Redevelopment telling him exactly who has won.

blocks.title: Suburban Redevelopment (Elysian Fields site)
paragraphs: Travel to the address and you’ll find it's actually a location of a housing development. Your arrival triggers a short scene with the foreman. Head inside the office and find a letter from someone named Leland Monroe. Phelps notes that Elysian Fields builds the houses while Suburban Redevelopment foots the bills.
Travel to the other house fire now.

blocks.title: Sawyer House Fire
paragraphs: When you arrive at the scene, you’ll see that the coroner’s wagon is there, which does not bode well. You’ll first chat to Albert Lynch, who is chief investigator for the LA Fire Department. He reports that a family of four was found dead in their beds after a water heater explosion, another InstaHeat model 70 like the Steffens.
Talk to Carruthers. He says the family died around midnight from carbon monoxide poisoning. They discuss the water heater problem, and Phelps alludes to “another angle” he’s thinking of.

Next, walk to the right of the rubble, towards the fire truck, and you should hear your clue chime to find the water heater regulator valve. It can be quite hard to spot. This triggers a series of events. First, Lynch praises the find as significant. Then a patrol officer brings forward Joanna Alford, who says that the family was supposed to have gone on a trip they had won, but the son got sick, so they stayed at home.

After this piece of disturbing information, Lynch spots a known firebug across the street. Take off after him. He runs up an alley and heads into a diner. Follow him through the diner and onto the street outside. You should be able to catch the guy after he jumps the fence across the street. If you can’t, he hides behind a wall and clotheslines you, triggering a brawl.

After taking him in, Phelps hauls him back to the house fire. His name is Herbert Chapman, and he admits to liking fires. Phelps turns out his pockets and finds a matchbox with a cigarette, which Lynch explains is an arsonist’s favourite way of setting a time-delay fire. He says if they want a longer delay, they use mosquito coil.
Before you leave, Lynch asks Phelps to stop by the fire station later on, as he has something to discuss with you. Head there next

blocks.title: Fire Station No. 32
paragraphs: Approach Lynch to trigger a scene. He suggests you take a look at the heater from the Sawyer house. Open it to find the service history. It was recently serviced by Reginald Varley.

Lynch then explains his theory. He shows you a gas supply, and a lit mosquito coil opposite each other, and a few other items. You must arrange the components to create an explosion. From left to right, you want the Bunsen burner, regulator valve and balloon. The following causes the balloon to expand, and touch the flame of the mosquito coil, causing the explosion.
Lynch hands over the regulator valve that you found at the Sawyer fire, and says you should take it to InstaHeat to see what they think.

blocks.title: InstaHeat Factory
paragraphs: Enter and speak to the receptionist. She directs you to the duty manager for the day, Ivan Rasic.

blocks.title: Ivan Rasic

topics.response: Phelps wants to verify that the reversed valve is not a manufacturing fault. Ivan seems nervous as he answers, and hedges his bets with “I don’t think”. Doubt him, and he admits that InstaHeat has now changed the design, but still installs model 70s because the demand is very high for water heaters at the moment.

topics.instruction: Heater Service History: Lie - Heater Serviced by Ryan/Varley
topics.response: Ivan admits that the rubber valves go bad after a while and have to be replaced. Phelps asks if all their fitters are qualified, to which he answers they are all licensed, but looks uneasy. You can bring up either “Heater Serviced by __” clue, it doesn’t matter which. Both clues cause Ivan to explain that the man you bring up has a troubled background. You get the statement and list of gas fitters clues regardless.

paragraphs: Firstly, Phelps hands over the regulator valve. Ivan tells you that the valve has been tampered with. The rubber diaphragm has been reversed, which would mean the gas never closes off properly, which would cause a leak. Then the interview begins

Next, use Ivan’s phone to call R&I to see what the criminal records of the gas fitters are like. 3 names come back. Walter Clemens is an arsonist, Ryan served time on assault charges, and Varlet is wanted for murder in Detroit. Clemens is added to your POI list, and all three criminal records get added to your clues.
Talk to Ivan again, and Phelps gets current locations for where the three men are working, and asks to see their lockers. Ivan reluctantly agrees to show you. Follow him.

When you get to the lockers, open Clemens locker, third from the left, and find Clemens anarchist pamphlet. Walk down a few lockers to find Ryan’s, and open it to find Ryan’s pamphlets, boxes of them. Looks like he’s distributing them.
Finally, head to Varley’s locker to find a box of mosquito coils. Examine it further to add it to your clues. Biggs explains to Ivan that the coil is a favourite form of ignition for arsonists.
As you leave the factory, you get an ominous scene where a man leans into a van and seems to fiddle with a familiar valve. The man gathers up his tools and heads for residential home.
Now, you’ll want to head to Clemens’s worksite first.

blocks.title: Clemens’s Worksite
paragraphs: Your arrival triggers a scene. Phelps and Biggs rough up Clemens a little, and then the interview starts.

blocks.title: Walter Clemens

topics.response: Phelps asks if Clemens knows Varley, to which he replies that he doesn’t. That’s a bit of a long shot considering his locker is a few feet away from Varley’s. Doubt him, and he says that Varley gets kickbacks from some developer to complete their repair jobs first. This adds the statement to your clues.

topics.instruction: Knowledge of Ryan: Accuse - Clemens’s Anarchist Pamphlet
topics.response: Phelps asks about Ryan next, and again, Clemens states that he doesn’t know the man. But you know they have met, as you found the leaflet in Clemens’s locker, so bring that up, and Clemens goes on about Ryan pushing those pamphlets at everyone, and says he’s “got it in for the company”

Phelps asks if Clemens is licensed and works for InstaHeat. He looks nervous, and defensively adds “so what?” to his statement of contracting for them. Doubt him, and he admits that his arson criminal record is for burning down his own home. When he explains the situation, Biggs is sympathetic.

paragraphs: Now it's time to head to Ryan’s Worksite.

blocks.title: Ryan’s Worksite
paragraphs: As Phelps approaches Ryan, the suspect hops in his work van and takes off. His route takes you straight through a busy construction site. Don’t rush this, as construction workers will run in front of your car if you aren’t careful. You’re best taking this slow, not hitting anyone, and then catching up properly when back on the streets to keep your five star rating.

Eventually, Ryan pulls onto Beverly Boulevard. As usual, pull up on the left side of the van and let Biggs shoot out the tires. When you take him out, the paddy wagon hauls him to the station for questioning later.

blocks.title: Varley’s Worksite
paragraphs: What is it with these people and running away? This time, Varley tries to escape on foot. You have to hold him up by holding your gun on him for the full count. Do not shoot him, or you fail the case, even if you shoot him in the leg. When you hold him up, he comes quietly.

blocks.title: Wilshire Station
paragraphs: Start with Varley. Find Interview room 2 and walk in. Varley speaks in disdain about Ryan, before the interview starts

blocks.title: Interview Reginald Varley

topics.instruction: Work at Sawyer Residence: Accuse - Heater Serviced by Varley
topics.response: Fairly easy one to sort through first. When questioned about the work done at the Sawyer residence, Varley claims no knowledge. He says he doesn’t do repair work, only installations. Use the Heater serviced by Varley clue to bring the truth out of him, he admits he worked at the Sawyer residence, and says that the Suburban Redevelopment wanted the Sawyers out of their home.

topics.instruction: Suburban Redevelopment: Accuse - Walter Clemens statement
topics.response: Phelps asks about the redevelopment, and if Varley is in the pocket of the fund. He denies it, but Clemens told you otherwise. Varley then admits he takes money off Suburban to boost them up his priority list, but that plenty of construction workers take these pay-offs.

Varley knows what happens if you reverse the regulator valve in a model 70. He denies doing it at the Sawyer house. Bring up the mosquito coils you found in his locker, and Varley claims they belong to Ryan.

paragraphs: You get the choice to charge Varley, or leave. We still have a suspect to talk to though, so leave and head to interview room 1, where Ryan confidently sits.

blocks.title: Matthew Ryan

topics.instruction: Anarchist Literature: Accuse - Ryan’s Anarchist Pamphlets
topics.response: Ryan admits that he wants to change the world, but he denies trying to sabotage the company. Bring up that you found the leaflets in his locker, and he admits he passes them out, and that he also holds InstaHeat in low esteem for their poor quality heaters.

topics.instruction: InstaHeat Model 70: Accuse - Ivan Rasic’s Statement
topics.response: Ryan denies that he knows how to reverse a regulator valve in the heaters. But Ivan Rasic mentioned it was a fairly simple job, and any of his staff could have done it. Bring it up, and Phelps reveals the lie for what it is. He also asks what caused Ryan’s own house fire, and Ryan refuses to say.

Phelps asks what Ryan knows about the Suburban Redevelopment fund, and Ryan says “nothing”. He doesn’t look sure of himself though, so doubt him and he says he has nothing to do with Suburban, but Varley has a “cosy agreement with those fascists”. This adds the final clue, Matthew Ryan’s Statement to your clues, but you won’t be using it.

Phelps suggests that Ryan has a history of violence, which he denies. But he doesn’t look entirely innocent, so doubt him, and Phelps pushes the murder charge further. Ryan points out the court ruled in his favour, but he lost his family in a water heater explosion and hates the company who makes them.

paragraphs: Now it's time to charge a suspect. For five stars, charge Ryan, as the captain is always happy to get an active anarchist off the streets.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Packard Custom
vehicleOpportunities.note: InstaHeat factory parking lot during “The Gas Man”

vehicleOpportunities.name: Oldsmobile Sedan
vehicleOpportunities.note: Parked on the curb outside the Steffens’ house fire in “The Gas Man”

vehicleOpportunities.name: Chevrolet Pickup 2
vehicleOpportunities.note: Clemen’s Worksite in “the Gas Man”, or the fenced parking lot at Cavanagh’s Bar in “The Driver’s Seat”

cases.title: A Walk in Elysian Fields
objectives: Interview Leland Monroe at Elysian Fields

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: The opening cinematic is a short one, and has nothing to do with the case as such. We see a man wearing a hat folding paper into an origami crane. The camera zooms out and shows that he is surrounded by these cranes.
In the station, Captain McKelty gives you your next case. Another deadly house fire, with 4 victims just like the Sawyer fire

blocks.title: Morelli House Fire
paragraphs: Approach the coroner at the front door and follow him inside. In the front room, you get a disturbing site. The charred bodies of the Morelli family, all positions on their knees as though praying. Albert Lynch believes they were moved into this position after the explosion, but before the fire, adding the bodies moved to your clues. He believes that the cause of death was asphyxiation from the gas inhalation, and that the family would have never felt a thing. He says the fire burns was after their death.
Inspect the bodies more closely, and then head to evidence marker to find a family photograph.

A scene will now trigger, where Phelps starts to link the crimes together once more. Biggs is sceptical, but to coroner and chief investigator seem to think the idea has merit. Phelps thinks that the arsonist feels guilty as he was supposed to burn houses, not families.

Mr Morelli collapses, and Biggs leaves the house, spooked. Carruthers suggests you head out to him. You can head down to the cellar to view the hole the explosion caused if you wish, but it isn’t a key clue. Head outside for another scene.

Biggs explains that he too has been affected by war, and the two discuss that for a while. Phelps then points out that the Morelli’s were on the list of contest winners from the previous case. Interesting. They decide to canvass the neighbourhood.
First, head around the house to find the water heater near the debris where the explosion took place. It's an InstaHeat Model 70! What a surprise.
Now head to the front yard and pick up the newspaper (#10) cinematic that is there, showing Doctor Fontaine dealing with a patient who looks familiar.

Now step over the low wall on the left side of the Morelli yard, and walk to the front corner of the neighbour's yard. There you will find boot prints and cigarette butts, which suggests that somebody was hanging around for quite a long time.

Now head to the neighbour standing at his front porch. Talk to him, and he says that the Morelli’s should have won a weekend away. He introduces himself as Dudley Foreman, and the interview sequence begins

blocks.title: Dudley Foreman

topics.instruction: Morelli Fire Witness Report: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps begins to ask for a statement about the fire, but he is cut off by Foreman saying he was asleep when the explosion occurred. He was rather quick to jump the gun then, so doubt him, and Phelps suggests that Foreman didn’t like Morelli much. Foreman says that Morelli was being difficult about selling his property to the developers. This adds new questions to your list, and gives you the houses to be demolished clue.

Phelps asks if anyone was hanging around last night at any point, and Foreman quickly replies “nope”. Again, it's a funny response, so doubt him, and Phelps presses a little, mentioning that there are signs of activity outside. This prompts Foreman to remember a guy, who he describes in detail. This adds Smoking Man to your POI. He thought the man was a pest exterminator.

Phelps asks about the demolitions. Foreman says that Elysian Fields is the property developer, and he’s surprised that Phelps hasn’t seen the billboards of Leland Monroe’s face beaming down at them. Phelps asks if Morelli had accepted an offer, and Foreman says he doesn’t know. Doubt him, and he says that Morelli build the property himself, and was being stubborn with selling it.

Foreman says the family was supposed to be away for the weekend, after winning a travel contest. When Phelps asks who ran the contest, Foreman says “What I don’t know”. This is actually the truth, despite it sounding a bit odd. He looks directly at you as he says it, unlike the other questions. So hit truth, and he says the competition was an incentive for the homeowners to think about selling.

paragraphs: Speak to Biggs, and he hands over something that he has found. It's an Origami Crane, and when it is unfolded, it is made out of the flyer from Elysian Fields. This gives you a new POI in Leland Monroe, and a new objective.

Next, you need to use a gamewell for an address for Elysian Fields. Call it in, and KGPL also puts you through to Captain McKelty. He strongly warns you to stay away from investigating Leland Monroe. Biggs suggests you head to the Rancho Escondido blaze.
Head there next.

blocks.title: Rancho Escondido
paragraphs: When you arrive, you are met with homeowners who lost their homes in the fire angrily confronting police officers. Soon a riot breaks out. Head in there and KO the two rioters to bring things under control.

Now, if you walk near the chimney of the nearest building, your chime will go off, giving you chance to examine the wall. Phelps notices that there is very poor quality cement. The wall also collapses. As well as giving you the clue you need, it also adds a new question to your interview with Leland Monroe later in the case.
You’ve seen all there is to see here. Head to Elysian Fields.

blocks.title: Elysian Fields
paragraphs: Head inside and rough up the secretary a little bit, threatening to get a warrant when she denies to entry. Soon, Leland Monroe himself comes out of his office and invites you in. Speak to him to trigger the interview.

blocks.title: Leland Monroe

topics.instruction: Elysian Linked to Arsons: Bad Cop
topics.response: Phelps points out that Elysian Fields flyers keep showing up at houses that burn down. Monroe says they advertise everywhere, so there’s no explanation needed. Doubt him, and Phelps simply points out that the burned down houses all seem to be reluctant to sell them to Elysian.

topics.instruction: Promotional Travel Contest: Accuse – Elysian Fields Flyers
topics.response: Phelps asks about the promotion, but Monroe claims that he is not familiar with it. His company runs many promotions. You have flyers with his face on saying otherwise. Phelps points out that the prizes are given to people who won’t sell their houses. Monroe explains that his face is simply the brand on the flyers, and that the mayor and chief of police are both part of Suburban Redevelopment as well.

Phelps asks what happens with holdouts like the Morellis. Monroe simply says that they find a way around the holdouts, and that business always finds a way. Doubt him, and Monroe claims that he would build around any holdout, but most people see sense.

topics.instruction: Rancho Escondido Fire: Accuse – Poor Cement Quality
topics.response: Phelps asks if the new development that burned down met building code regulations. Monroe says it was, but you know that it wasn’t from when you paid a visit. Bring up the Poor Cement Quality you found, and Monroe says that the buildings were all fully inspected and insured by California Fire and Life. He then offers you a list of contractors he uses.

paragraphs: Approach the Secretary and pick up the list of contractors. Notice a familiar name? Herbert Chapman, the firebug you chased down in the previous case. Tap on it, and you get the objective to find him.

Find a telephone. Go down to the lobby receptionist and turn right, through the big green doors. Use one of the phones on a desk. Phelps learns that Chapman has been released, so Phelps puts out an APB on him to be found.
Finishing the phone call fades the screen black, and then shows a scene at the Blue Room jazz club that night.
In the scene, Roy Earle joins you to give you a warning to stay away from Elysian Fields. He also tells you that Homicide is taking over the Morelli case
The next morning, Biggs picks you up from Elsa’s apartment and says that he got the same warning from Captain McKelty last night.
You get a call from KGPL with Herbert Chapman’s last known address. Head there next.

blocks.title: Chapman’s Apartment
paragraphs: When you arrive, you have a quick chat with the Landlord, who says that Chapman isn’t at home. His van is parked on the lawn though, so open the back door.
Inside, examine the mosquito coils, and then the ammunition. Phelps points out that Chapman is clearly armed. Finally, examine the Elysian Fields flyer.
After putting down the final item, Biggs notices Chapman coming out of Superior Laundry down the street. The suspect also spots you, and pulls out his gun, hopping aboard an electric trolley car.

Follow the trolley. He takes control of it, and starts ploughing through traffic. Unlike most chases, the wheels aren’t available to shoot out at the start of the chase. Instead, pull up along the side, and slam into the middle of the trolley, where you’ll see the word Electric, and you’ll knock off a side panel, exposing the wheels. Then it's like a normal chase, have Biggs shoot out the wheels. When the trolley halts, Exit the vehicle and take out Chapman before he has chance to take you out with his pistol.
After you receive praise from your captain for taking out the firebug, you’ll get a scene setting up the next case.

Elsa gets a letter with a generous insurance settlement over the death of her friend Lou. Phelps suggests she should have an insurance investigator look at the matter, his old wartime friend Jack Kelso.

cases.title: House of Sticks
objectives: Investigate Elysian Fields Office and Subdue Foreman
Investigate Demolished House and Escape Bulldozer
Escape Pursuers and Get to Elsa’s Apartment

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Now you will play as Jack Kelso, and begin in his office at California Fire and Life. The scene begins with Elsa Lichtmann coming to see Kelso and handing him the settlement letter.

Read through the letter. Kelso admits that it is a ridiculously large amount for a settlement. Elsa then tells Kelso she believes her friend, Lou Buchwalter, was the victim of foul play. Kelso then gets out the Buchwalter Case File.
Read through the information, then when done, the interview starts up.

blocks.title: Elsa Lichtmann

topics.response: Kelso asks about the basis for Elsa’s claim. She says that Lou was a craftsman, and wouldn’t build a faulty roof. It's a flimsy reason, so doubt her, and Kelso pushes her, saying that her intuition isn’t enough to reopen the case. She insists there was something wrong with the house Lou died in.

When Kelso asks why Lou made Elsa the beneficiary if they weren’t married, Elsa simply says they were family friends. Doubt her again to get more info. They were both interned on Ellis Island for four years, and Nazis killed their parents. They were both confined to the island as “Alien Germans”

Kelso states that accidents happen and wonders what Elsa actually wants. She looks you in the eye and says that she wants the building investigated. It's true, so believe her, and Kelso says he needs more information. She then tells him that there is a conspiracy that includes Elysian Fields and Kelso’s own company.

paragraphs: As the interview ends, Kelso asks for her address and phone number. She hands you the slip of paper clue and leaves. Kelso’s secretary appears and tells him that Curtis Benson wants to see him in his office upstairs.
Follow the secretary upstairs and into Benson’s office. Benson tells Kelso to forget about investigating what Elsa just told you, and get her to take the payoff. Interesting.
You’ll want to leave now and travel to Elysian Fields Subdivision Office next. Note that even though you don't have a partner, you can still use Y to fast-travel and avoid driving.

blocks.title: Elysian Fields Subdivision Office
paragraphs: Travel to Elysian Fields site. Enter the subdivision office and find the cement delivery receipt on the leftmost desk. Kelso remarks that the ratio used in the cement mix is not a good mix, and someone is cutting corners.

Now go to the right most desk and find the demolition order. It orders the destruction of all buildings associated with the incident of 01/28/1947, the date Lou died. The order also calls for all the building material to be removed. Possibly as a cover up? Then examine the company memo next to it, Leland Monroe is putting pressure on his workers to work fast.
As you exit the office, the site foreman, Frank Osterman, confronts Kelso and a fistfight starts. Put him down, and Frank tells you the site where Lou died.

blocks.title: Elysian Fields house
paragraphs: Travel the short distance to the demolished house. The rubble is still there. There are a couple of red flags showing places of interest. Head to them and find some pieces of wood with the words “Not for construction use” and a brick with next to no mortar on it. Around the back of the debris, you’ll find a piece of broken wood that you must piece together from several to make the words “Keystone Films”. Using props in construction now?

As you set the wood down, and scene triggers. Franks back, and he’s brought his mate, Mr B. Dozer. Seriously, he’s in a bulldozer. Anyway, you have to run, obviously, away from Frank and his heavy artillery. When you get chance, turn to face him and try to get a shot off. Do this quick however, as otherwise he’ll raise the bulldozer blade and block your shot. If you make it to the end, there's a ladder you can climb to escape. This may take a few attempts but there’s nothing tied to it except progression.

After dodging the bulldozer, you have to find an address for Keystone Studios. Jump in your car and find the nearest phone icon on the map. Call up R&I and get the address before fast travelling there.

blocks.title: Keystone Film Studios
paragraphs: This area is kind of big, so I’ll do my best to describe the locations of the clues. Kelso starts by bribing the guard to let him in.

You’ll want to start by jumping the gate on the right after the red and white barrier. Examine the lumber found there. On the first pile of lumber you’ll find the Lumber Delivery Receipt, showing a hundred pallets of this lumber have been purchased. Next head to the other pile of lumber near the fence and you’ll find a sign that indicates the inferior quality of the lumber. It's definitely not enough for use on the roof.
Move around the corner of the building you’re next to and follow the fence to the building labelled stage 3. Turn left, and go straight ahead to the door that is labelled “Screening Room”

On the table to the right is a film canister you’ll want to look at., the title is “Suburban Redevelopment Fund”. The canister is empty, because the film is loaded into the projector. Examine the projector and you’ll start the film.

Turn the top dial to focus the film in, the middle dial to adjust the film speed, and then flick the bottom switch. When you get it right, the film will start and you’ll be able to watch it. It holds lots of plot information.
Find the phone located at the guard post at the entrance, and phone Curtis Benson, who gives you another strict warning. Then phone Elsa Lichtmann and arrange a meeting.
Watch the long scene at the Blue Room with Kelso, Phelps and Elsa. You’ll now have to travel to Elysian Fields Site 2

blocks.title: Elysian Fields Site 2
paragraphs: On arrival, Kelso spots a flickering light in the upstairs window of the house. Enter the house and try the light switch, no wiring! Head to the kitchen and try the taps, no plumbing either. Now head upstairs and into the main bedroom to trigger a scene. Kelso manages to get out having a shoot up, and instead you have to have a fist fight.
You can’t actually win the fight, so make a last stand to make yourself feel better, before going down to the numbers game.

Kelso’s knockout triggers another scene. They toss Kelso into the boot of their car. Kelso awakens as they pull into Elysian Fields offices. Listen to the phone conversation and then watch as Kelso escapes out of the trunk.

Now it's time to flee. Sprint to the car across the street from the headquarters, a nice little Buick Coupe. You have to try to lose all of the thugs chasing you. Best way is to drive fast and in a zig-zag pattern to get away. Try to break their line of site and take an unexpected turning when they can’t see you. When you’re free of the thugs, head to the yellow flag, which is Elsa’s apartment. This ends the case.

cases.title: A Polite Invitation
objectives: Search Curtis Benson’s Apartment and Interview Benson
Review Buchwalter Case File at Kelso’s Office
Find Land Registry Office in Hall of Records
Fight Your Way Out of Hall of Records

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Kelso awakens in a medical centre with Elsa watching over him. She apologises and says that Phelps needs his help. Kelso says she was right about Elysian Fields

As Elsa leaves, Assistant District Attorney Peterson drops in. He’s running for DA, and wants to start rooting out the corruption in the administration. He offers Kelso the position at Special Investigator, and says he’s going after the Vice Squad. Kelso offers him something better, Leland Monroe.
You begin with both of the clues listed above carried over from the previous case. Easy progress. Exit the room, head downstairs and find your car.

blocks.title: Curtis Benson’s Apartment
paragraphs: Travel to Benson’s apartment. Check the mailboxes to find out where you are going, apartment 2. Climb the stairs, turn left and follow the walkway to apartment 2. Knock, and Benson answers.
Kelso demands that Benson tells him everything about his relationship with Leland Monroe. Benson is less than co-operative, so Kelso gives him ‘incentive’, and announces he’s taking a look around.

Go past Benson to the table in the back left corner of the room and you’ll find a California Fire and Life insurance agreement that insures the Rancho Escondido housing development for Elysian Fields. Then look at the nearby folder on the dining table, which holds the share certificates showing that Benson holds stock in the Suburban Redevelopment Fund.
Head to the bedroom door on the left side of the sofa. Kelso kicks open the door and exposes Benson’s debauchery, which infuriates Kelso. Now interview Benson.

blocks.title: Curtis Benson

topics.instruction: Motive for Fraud: Accuse – Share Certificates
topics.response: Kelso asks why the vice president of a company would take such a huge risk. Benson replies that it is a business transaction. Bring up the share certificates and Benson shows he has some pent up anger towards California Fire and Life.

Kelso asks about the funds real purpose. Benson says it is just business people meeting people’s needs. The insurance papers say otherwise, but Benson laughs them off and says the stakes are much higher than replacement costs.

Kelso brings up the cheap building materials that lead to Lou’s death. Benson suggests that he knew nothing about Monroe’s building materials. Doubt him, and Benson laughs, saying everything an investigator needs to know is there in the case file.

paragraphs: Time to head back to California Fire and Life to check that file.

blocks.title: California Fire and Life (Kelso’s Office)
paragraphs: Walk past the enquiries desk and to the elevators on the back wall. Kelso’s office is first on the right after you go up a floor.

The case file is on Kelso’s desk. Open it, then tap the map coordinates, which Kelso notes out loud. Then look at the pink slip details, and tap the independent valuation, which shows the values at $3,500, whereas the insurance was only for $900. The increased land value is key.
When you’ve finished, the secretary ushers in Phelps, and the two have a lengthy chat about past and present. Kelso suggest the next move needs to be head to the Hall of Records.

blocks.title: Hall of Records
paragraphs: You’ll be taken automatically to the Hall of Records. Enter the building and approach the guard to trigger a scene. Kelso asks about the land registry office, and the guard directs him upstairs. Climb the stairs and follow the “Land Registry” sign to the office, and the approach the clerk.

Kelso asks for the company details of the Suburban Redevelopment Fund. The clerk leads you to a shelf marked “S” full of ledgers. Inspect the shelf to pull out the ledger you need and open it. Turn the page to the list of company directors, and make sure you tap on Courtney Sheldon’s name to add him to you POI list.

Kelso then asks about a specific plot of land. As you only have coordinates, the clerk takes you to a plotting mechanism. Enter the latitude: 34 degrees, 04 minutes, 29 seconds, and the longitude: 118 degrees, 17 minutes, 58 seconds, which gives you the Elysian Fields lot number 1876988

Now to make things complicated, you must find the lot information. Take the number we just found, and divide it by 90,000 on the calculator to get 20. Then you are told that A is 0, and it goes up, so you’re looking for the 21st letter of the alphabet, which is U. Head to the shelf to find what you need.

Kelso takes out the correct book. Find lot number 1876988. The listed owner is Randall Jones, and the listed value is $350. But Kelso notes that with the new home in place, the value is $3,500. They can make a killing, as Kelso puts it. But how?

After viewing the ledger, Kelso starts to leave, but some goons turn up and start shooting the place up. This time, you have a weapon, so use it to gun down the guys. Keep an eye on your minimap to find the red dots and flush them out.

When the last guy falls, you automatically get taken to a scene later in the day. Kelso stops at the USC school of medicine and has a nice chat with Courtney Sheldon, one of the key investors in the Suburban Redevelopment.

Sheldon seems mystified when Kelso lays out everything he knows about the fund. He tells the whole story, but holds far too much faith in Fontaine to think badly of him. Kelso says it plainly; he’s been played for a fool.

blocks.title: Kelso’s Apartment
paragraphs: The scene cuts to a hallway outside Kelso’s apartment. Enter the first door on the right. Kelso’s phone is ringing, so answer it. It's Leland Monroe! He wants to meet you at his mansion that night. Yeah, ok, we’re that gullible. Kelso says he might come, but after hanging up, immediately starts to dial another number.

blocks.title: Leland Monroe’s Mansion
paragraphs: Travel to Monroe’s mansion, and your arrival triggers a scene. Kelso has assembled a team of former 6th marines to help him storm the palace. The battle starts in the gardens.

Use cover wisely and keep an eye on your minimap. Always make sure that the guy you are shooting at is an enemy, not an ally. Four goons begin the battle, but reinforcements come out of the front doors.
When you finally reach the house, approach the front doors to kick them open. Take cover immediately and there are two guys waiting for you. Take them out, and head into the entrance hall.
Use the same tactic at the next door to take out the guy waiting for you, and when you kick open the third door, a little scene triggers with the secretary.
Kick through two more doors to reach the central hall leading to the main staircase. Two guards on the ground level, two on the upper level. Take them out.

Climb the stairs and follow the hall to the open doorway leading to the bathroom. Enter and go through the left door to enter Monroe’s office and trigger a scene. Monroe is opening his safe as Kelso walks in. Kelso gets a neat thigh shot as his opening bargaining position.

Now search the office. Open the safe and examine the objects inside. You’ll find some stock certificates and a green notebook which lists payouts to the cops of LA, including your old partner Roy Earle! There’s also a police dossier on Harlan Fontaine.
Now find the folder on Monroe’s desk and open it to see a list of homeowner holdouts, including family names from Phelps’ arson cases.

Finally, look behind Monroe’s desk and find the eleventh newspaper article, showing the final meeting between Sheldon and Fontaine, and a framed photograph of the directors of the Suburban Redevelopment Fund.

After reviewing all the evidence, Kelso uses Monroe’s phone to contact Phelps, and tells Biggs to come pick up Monroe. Kelso learns about what you are about to see after the case report screen of this case.
