blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: Less of a briefing and more of a regular cutscene. You and your partner are driving around when a huge explosion rocks LA. Haul ass over there and discover a large area of destruction.

blocks.title: Explosion Site
paragraphs: The first thing you have to do is take out some scum who are using the explosion to loot the area. Kill the two guys, and then follow your partner to find the coroner, who has a couple of bodies with him. After a quick examination, you get to look around the site.

Continue further on, and turn left at the vehicles. You’ll see two men talking, walk past them. The path will fork, head left first and under a bent L beam. You’ll find the clue Laundry Tag if you examine a tattered garment there.

Continue along the path and an officer will call you over. Investigate the case inside the locker, and open it to find a few items. First, pick up the camera for the Spy Camera and Espionage clues, then examine the golden earring thing that doesn’t give you a clue, but is important to the case, and Phelps pockets it. Then the business card gives you a new POI, and finally, the paper with a ring gives you a puzzle to solve.

H=K. Move the outer ring so that K is at the top under the red arrow, then the inner ring so that H is at the top. Then, moving the outer ring moves both rings. You want to get the letters written on the piece of paper as your inner ring, then the outer ring will tell you the equivalent letter for the cipher. You’ll end up with the address N VERMONT AVE, and the clue.
Take the path back out where you entered and chat to the owner of the Electroplating company, Mr Nicholson.

topics.instruction: Whereabouts of Okamoto: Accuse - Spy Camera

topics.response: Head for the address you deciphered at Vermont Ave.

blocks.title: Deciphered Address
paragraphs: Look at the mailboxes to find that Okamoto is in apartment 1, then head upstairs, and the first door on your right. Enter and see it's been ransacked. Start poking around.
Firstly, open the fridge and a dead body falls out. Examine the head to get the John Doe POI, then the right and left hands for the ring and wristwatch clues.
Leave the body, then go to the fireplace. There’s a shiny object on the hearth, which is the Tie Pin. Walk towards the bedroom door and check the bloodstain, which isn’t a clue.
Use the phone in the apartment to call in for the address for Superior Laundry Services, then return to your car and head there.

blocks.title: Superior Laundry Services
paragraphs: Head to the desk at the back and chat to the guy there, who gives you a ledger to check out. Look for the entry for J2620, to get a POI Oscar Hangstrom.
On your way out, check the phone and your clue for the Prop Spinner/Airplane Part updates.

blocks.title: Hughes Aircraft
paragraphs: Watch the cutscene, then follow Vernon Mapes into the facility. Another cutscene, then interview Mapes

blocks.title: Vernon Mapes

topics.instruction: Knowledge of McLellan: Accuse - Prop Spinner
topics.response: Now go up the stairs behind you and enter the office. In the back, there is a desk with two photos on. The first gives you an unknown address, and the other gives you the Photograph clue. Go out of the office and into the hangar, and go straight to the three engines in front of you after you go down the stairs.

paragraphs: Look at the centre engine, then walk to the nose of the airplane. Examine the barrels for Linseed Oil. Climb the stairs into the plane and then go up the ladder. Check the bulletin board, which has the clue Navigation Notes, with coordinates on.
Using this, walk to the nose of the plane and sit behind the console on the right. Put in the coordinates.
Latitude: 24 degrees 15 minutes N Longitude 76 Degrees 00 minutes W
And you’ll get the Bahamas clue. (Note that if you look at the map itself, the lines of longitude are drawn backwards. Use the gauge on top of the map to set the location.)
Now head for the police station.

blocks.title: Wilshire Police Station
paragraphs: Find your way to tech services and speak to Pinker. He will show you some photos. Make sure to examine them closely for extra information.
Photo 1 - Phelps (no information) Photo 2 - Zoom in on watch and ring Photo 3 - Zoom in on tie pin Photo 4 - Zoom in on notes Photo 5 - Zoom in on the two men Photo 6 - Zoom in on house number.
Pinker wants you to do some chemistry now. Simply put a drop from each bottle into the dish, and watch the fireworks.
Before you leave, walk around the desk and use the magnifying glass to zoom in on the document to get the Aluminium Polishing Patent clue.

blocks.title: House in the Photograph
paragraphs: Enter the house and investigate the gas on the floor. Walk to the bedroom and look at the little table which has a ticket and a passport on it. Look at them both, and then you’ll be attacked. Someone is trying to torch the house.
Shoot the gas bottle (red things always explode in games) and get out of the house.

He leads you through a few alleyways and streets as you go, but should be fairly easy to keep up with, providing you watch out for traffic. Eventually, you reach a shootout area, which is Hughes Aircraft

blocks.title: Hughes Aircraft
paragraphs: You have to shoot the drivers of two of the four MP vehicles before they come to a stop. You’ll need to practise where the vehicles come, they do appear as red markers on your map. Use auto aim (you can increase sensitivity in options) to home in on the drivers and pile bullets through the windshield. Equipping the Sharpshooter outfit (even though it claims to not work on machine guns) seemed to help quite a bit. (It certainly can't hurt.)
The first vehicle appears in front of you, coming from your left. Due to how fast this car arrives and driver is on the far side of the car, this one is almost impossible to shoot.

Instead, ignore him and head to the trunk of your car and pull out a machine gun. Stay in the street and kill a couple of guys to spawn the next vehicle, but don’t use all your ammo. Stand in the middle of the street and the car drives straight at you. If you're lucky, you'll be lined up nicely to take out the driver as he drives straight towards you.

The 3rd and 4th drivers spawn inside the gate: the 3rd comes from your left while the 4th comes from your right. The 3rd is definitely the easier of the two to shoot -- ideally you want to run from the street into the center of the area (hopefully keeping enough cover so you don't get killed) to get a good shot on the driver. If you don't nail him, you might have luck turning around and hitting car #4.

This is not the final level so I recommended playing the next level before replaying previous levels. This is usually the reason you would have failed to, as following the guide, you cannot branch any questions wrongly or miss any clues.

cases.title: A Different Kind of War
objectives: Investigate Nuclear Bug and Rodent Control
Escort Kelso to L.A River Tunnels Entrance
Fight Through Tunnels to Pump House

blocks.title: Briefing
paragraphs: The case starts with a cutscene showing Elsa attending a therapy session with Dr. Fontaine which ends rather badly.

Kelso knows the arsonist who killed Dr Fontaine and kidnapped Elsa is a bug sprayer and a big “cowboy” type. These things are added to your notebook at the start of this case. But no clues just yet. Kelso has torn the page for bug killer out of a phone book, which gives you three locations to visit. First, head to Rapid Exterminators.

blocks.title: Rapid Exterminators
paragraphs: Approach the man at the desk. Kelso asks him if he employs a big cowboy as a bug sprayer. The guy says no.
Before you leave, pick up the twelfth newspaper on the desk.
Next go to Nuclear Bug and Rodent Control.
Same deal here, approach the desk, Kelso asks about a bug sprayer with a cowboy accent. The man replies negative. Leave and head to the final pest control store.

blocks.title: Westlake Pest Control
paragraphs: Approach the desk. This time you finally get some information. The big cowboy lives in a bunkhouse on the remains of the old Rancho Rincon.
After you get this information, the scene shifts to Dr. Fontaine’s surgery the previous day.

blocks.title: Dr. Fontaine’s Office (The day before)
paragraphs: Watch the introductory scene. Phelps and Biggs arrive at the office, where Rusty meets you and gives them a briefing. Dr. Fontaine is dead, and a nurse saw one of his patients – “Some big Boris Karloff type” – carrying out Elsa.
Follow Galloway through the secretary’s office and into a small anteroom outside Fontaine’s main office. Examine the morphine syrette box to discover Fontaine’s morphine cabinet.

Continue into the office. First, find the folder on the small table beside the door, and examine it to get Fontaine’s blackmail papers that tie Leland Monroe to the arsons. Read Fontaine’s note, and be sure to turn the pages and select Sawyer name that is circled to get the clue. There’s also a psychiatric report on the cowboy bug killer.
Next, pick up the blood-stained crystal ball lying on the floor. You can also examine the broken glass, and the body of Fontaine, but nothing of any worth is gained from this.

Finally, inspect Fontaine’s desk. Examine the map on the left. Use the charcoal marker to shade the blank paper and reveal the markings below, which all tie to Elysian Fields new developments. But what does it mean?

To find out, select the newspaper clipping next to the map, and Phelps slides it under the route. All of the places marked are in the way of the new Freeway that is going to be built. Phelps now realises the true nature of the redevelopment scam.
Be sure to pick up the final newspaper (#13) article and view the story behind the headlines.
You’ll now return to the present day.

blocks.title: Rancho Rincon Bunkhouse (Present day)
paragraphs: Kelso automatically arrives at the Rancho Rincon Bunkhouse. Approach the door to knock, but you get no answer. So kick the door in and enter. Just inside, search the worktable on the right to find a flamethrower. In the kitchen, you’ll find a familiar item, a pressure valve for an InstaHeat Model 70.
Enter the door on the right, just off the living room. Kelso enters and finds room full of origami cranes. Be sure to pick one up to get the clue.

Examine the map of the LA river tunnels, hanging on the wall behind the candles, which get added to your locations. Then examine the wall to the right and find the photos of Okinawa. Then it hits Kelso. He knows the name of the guy who has Elsa.

This triggers a scene. Kelso uses the bunkhouse telephone to call his new boss, the assistant DA, and reports his findings. He tells Peterson to meet him at the La Tunnel entrance, and sends an urgent radio message for Cole Phelps.

blocks.title: Wilshire Police Station
paragraphs: Phelps gets Kelso’s message, and heads off to meet him at the same tunnel entrance. Kelso’s car is being targeted by crooked cops who want him dead, so Phelps decides to lend a hand.

Escort Kelso to the tunnel entrance. Basically, just take out the other police cars that are targeting Kelso’s car, and after a while, your own car. Ram into anything that is marked with a red icon on your map, and ignore the fact that they are cops. Eventually, the two of you reach the tunnels entrance, and meet up with Peterson.

blocks.title: LA River Tunnels
paragraphs: Kelso and Phelps split up and start searching for the kidnapper. Your goal is to reach the Jackson Street Pump Room. There are a lot of goons in the tunnels trying to take you out, so keep an eye on the minimap for red dots.
Begin by heading east, taking out the cops in the first tunnel. It would be a good idea to pick up some heavier firepower to help you.
Follow the path until you reach a side tunnel on your left, heading north and take it. It is marked on the wall as Almeda Outlet A2. Follow that passage until the end.
Around the next corner there is a caution sign above a narrow tunnel with a closed gate at the end. Proceed to the spillway about halfway down the tunnel and hop in.
Follow the spillway to the next tunnel, then turn right and follow the water to the ladder beside the gate. Take out the gunmen as you approach and climb the ladder he came down.

Follow the walkway overlooking the water until you reach a small room stocked with weapons. Take something big, then exit the storeroom and go right, then right again to the next tunnel, labelled “Santa Fe Outlet”

This tunnel is lined with big pipes you can use for cover. Be aware that enemies can also use them as cover though, so keep your wits about you. Fight down to the far end, and you’ll see a cop get toasted by Ira, the cowboy guy. The flamethrower you found wasn’t his only one.
Follow the bridge across the water to the doorway labelled “Santa Fe/Jackson St Vault Room” which leads to a walkway over a huge room.
Take cover behind a metal sheet and start firing across at the goons who come out at you. You get help from the flamethrower again, but check below you for people that get missed.
When the coast is clear, turn right and go down the staircase to the lower level of the vault room. Be ready for another squad of shooters in the corridor at the bottom of the stairs.

Fight your way down the corridor and find another armory of weapons. Stock up on ammo and leave, turning left as you do, taking the ladder down into the water. This triggers a cutscene, and water surges into the vault room as the rain outside swells the river.

Wade through the rising water to the opposite corner of the vault room and climb the ladder. If you don’t hurry, Kelso will drown, so be quick. Fight your way down the next corridor to the stairs at the end and climb them.

Take cover at the top of the stairs and take out the shooters waiting on the walkways. Run down the walkway to the first passage on the left, labelled “Jackson Pump Room” and head down it to finish the main storyline.

streetCrimes.title: Boxing Clever
paragraphs: Be around South Main Street between these hours to receive a call to tend to this crime. Somebody has looted a drugstore. The suspect takes off running when you enter the shop. Chase him through the back hallway. He runs down the alleyway, but gets cut off by a civilian vehicle, causing him to veer left and jump a fence. Pursue him up the ladder he climbs. If you get too close, he will kick you and impede your progress. Once on the second floor of the structure, follow the suspect around to the left to a second ladder.
With nowhere to go on this floor, the suspect resorts to brawling. Get in a few good shots and you’ll soon see the finish icon. This ends the case.

streetCrimes.title: Cosmic Rays
paragraphs: You get a call to tend to a disturbance at the Alaco gas station on 7th and Flower, a possible mental case. After watching the quick cutscene, chase the suspect towards Maybelle’s Fried Chicken, and take a sharp left in front of the store. People will point you in the right direction.
As the chase ends, you’ll find the man on the edge of a building rooftop. He gives a salute and chucks himself off to finish the case.

streetCrimes.title: Masked Gunman
paragraphs: There are reports of a burglary at 6th and Ceres. Arrive and a witness says she has seen the suspect on a nearby roof.
Climb the ladder to the rooftop, run across the rooftop and slide down the pipe at the other side, then climb the fence on your left.

Run towards Ceres Ave and turn left around the building to chase the suspect through the crowds. Avoid bumping into people to keep up your speed. He goes left through the first gate opening. Follow him through a parking lot and over a brick wall. When you vault the wall, immediately draw your weapon and shoot the man to finish the case. If you do manage this, he ends up taking a hostage. The trick here is to not move where you are aiming when the cinematic ends and he will put his head directly in your line of fire for an easy kill.

streetCrimes.title: Shoo Shoo Bandits
paragraphs: Incident is at Angel’s Flight Railway, on 3rd and Hill Street. A man has been robbed; they’ve taken his shoes too. You are faced in the direction of the last known whereabouts of the suspects. There is an alleyway at the top of the second flight of stairs. Head down there, left, and you’ll find the robbers down there.

Take cover behind a dumpster and fire on the armed suspects. The two men can escape in a car, and get away from you, failing the case, if you do not take them out quick enough. Use automatic aim to get them before this happens and retrieve the man’s shoes. If you don’t take them out before the second guy enters the getaway vehicle, aim at the back of his head through the back window and plough bullets through it until you hear his head hit the horn.

streetCrimes.title: Gangfight
paragraphs: 1624 West 3rd street. Uniformed officer tells you 2 gangs are sizing each other up. As the cinematic ends, the first shot is fired. Take down all of the shooters. Best idea is to wait a few seconds before firing a shot, as the guys will start advancing, leaving their cover. Then advance your cover to take out the other four guys. Then take out the two guys who arrive as reinforcements from a safe distance.

streetCrimes.title: Amateur Hour
paragraphs: Sillman’s Jewelry store at 829 South Olive. Robbery in process. They spot you as your team gets ready to start the raid. The store is dark, but you get a flashlight automatically. Step through the hole, ignoring the surrendering woman, and head towards the red blip. Gun him down when he pops up from behind the counter, then head for the stairs. Walk backwards up the stairs, as they will be above and behind you. Check for the two red blips and gun them down, walking back downstairs if you get into trouble to use the floor as cover.

Head back to the hole in the wall, and you’ll see the surrendering female suspect stepping over Bekowsky, who has been knocked out. She gets in a car and tries to take off. Try to get a shot in at her, but if you can’t, she crashes into a wall anyway and you just have to wander up to make the arrest.

streetCrimes.title: Death From Above
paragraphs: Shatto and Valencia, shots fired, officer in trouble. Guys have taken the officer as a hostage and are on top of the building. You can take out the guys you can see from where you start: two guys up on the tall building. Move right, and shoot the third guy on the lower building.

Head towards where that third gunman was and follow your partner up a drain. You’ll find the body of the third gunman up here. Don’t take his weapon, you won’t need it. Climb the ladder to the next rooftop. The officer has a gun to his head and is being used as a human shield.

Easy way to do this is to not touch where you are aiming at all from the cinematic. After a second, the guy pops his head out from behind his hostage, right onto your marker. Shoot and end the mission. You fail if you wait too long, because he’ll kill his hostage.

streetCrimes.title: Theatre Robbery
paragraphs: 933 South Broadway, the United Artists Theatre. Armed gunman threatens to kill the ticket booth employee if she calls the cops, but she’s already tripped the alarm. You can see his blue car driving away from the scene.

Stay as close as you can to the suspect. If you lose him, check the minimap and don’t let him escape too far or you’ll fail. Be careful of the narrow alleyways and make sure you don’t hit the dumpsters or other objects that will impede your progress. You’ll struggle to actually take out his wheels or ram him, so stay on him until he comes to a stop. He starts to run on foot.

Follow him up the pipe at the back of the parking lot. Warning shots are not an option, because he’s armed, so just gun him down when you get the chance, or he’ll eventually stop to make things a gunfight. Either way, take him out to end the case.

streetCrimes.title: Pawnshop Holdup
paragraphs: Kick in the door, then the second door and take cover. 2 guys across the room, both in cover. Try to take them from a distance, as one has a shotgun. The remaining guy has gone up to the roof and taken a hostage with him. Run up the stairs and you’ll see one hostage, dead. Head up the next set of stairs to trigger the hostage scene.
Again, don’t move your aim and he’ll move his head into your line of sight. Shoot him and end the mission.

streetCrimes.title: Hotel Bandits
paragraphs: Bristol Hotel at 437 8th Street. Guy with a shotgun holding up the clerk of the hotel. When he sees you he takes off running. Go through the hotel entrance and follow your partner into the back-right hallway. Once you reach the end of this hallway, exit the building through the open doorway. Turn left through the alleyway and join your partner to see the suspect jacking a car and taking off.

Follow in the car you hijack, staying as close as possible as usual. The car hangs a left onto 6th, then a right onto Olive. Let your partner get a clean shot on the tires. As you cross the junction of 4th and Olive, the suspect veers into a parking lot and again takes off running up some stairs. If you’re close enough, you may be able to gun him down here, but if not, then follow him up to the top of the stairs.
You will instantly be shot at. There are two gunmen. Draw and auto aim at one of the guys to take him out quickly, before taking cover behind a vehicle. Then take the other down routinely.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Cord 810 Softtop
vehicleOpportunities.note: Find the old two story building on Mateo Street, right at the southern part of the map. It's on a sublevel of this building, down a slope going behind it. Alternatively, this car can be driven during the street crime “Hotel Bandits” as a chase car.

streetCrimes.title: Army Surplus
paragraphs: 540 West 9th Street at Uncle Sam’s Army Surplus. Uniformed officer has two robbers at gunpoint when the drunken store owner comes out waving a gun. This distraction gives the robbers enough time to pull out their own weapons.
Remain in the building as your partner lays down some cover fire, and take down both men from where you are, ending the case quickly.

streetCrimes.title: Hung Out To Dry
paragraphs: 536 South Figueroa, Hoelcher’s Textiles, reported burglary. Four male suspects believed to be in the building. Cover the left side of the entrance, while your partner covers the right wall. You’ll find 5 guys talking. Swing out and shoot as many as you can before they settle into cover. From this position, you shouldn’t have any trouble taking out the three closest to you. Then move and cover behind the columns to take out the other two.
When these five are taken down, another appears on your map. Head to the back room and train your gun on the stairs as you advance and you’ll be able to take him out without any trouble.
Homicide Desk

streetCrimes.title: Vengeful Ex
paragraphs: Disturbance at Olvera Street Plaza. Old man with a gun arguing with his wife, officer gets involved and is shot. Find the suspect on your map and head towards him, ducking in and out of cover to avoid his gunfire. An out of control truck nails the lady who was in the dispute, and you’ll have to go round it. The guy flees, but keeps taking pot-shots at you as he does. He runs left down a row of pallets, and stops at the end to look around, so this is your best chance to take him, but there are plenty of opportunities.

streetCrimes.title: Death Plunge
paragraphs: Possible jumper at the Methodist Church on the corner of 8th and Hope. There’s a cop trying to calm him down, but you’ll have to race up to the bell tower to get to the guy first. It is timed, but there is no way of telling exactly how you are doing, so just go as fast as you can. Follow your partner as he veers left into an alleyway, then left again around a corner. There’s a pipe leading to the roof you need to climb. Follow Galloway again, and he stops facing your destination, so run past him and up the ladder to the bell tower. Complete in time to close the case.

streetCrimes.title: Canned Fish
paragraphs: Suspicious activity at 111 South Alameda. When you arrive at the warehouse, the guys spot you and a fight breaks out. Brawl your guy until he’s unconscious without worrying about Galloway. Once both are down, the third guy, who you may recognise as Frank Morgan from the main story, gets into the stolen truck and takes off. Do your best to disable the vehicle, but you don’t have to manage it, because eventually Frank drops into the flood control channel and his vehicle cuts out, allowing you to arrest him.

streetCrimes.title: Would Be Robber
paragraphs: Man with a gun on Grand between 4th and 5th. As you are receiving the information, the suspects drive off quickly. Follow them as close as you can, they take the first two immediate rights, then a left into an alley. After the alley, they get out at a gas station and one takes a hostage. As before, the trick is not to adjust your aim from the cinematic and pop his head off when he moves it into your line of fire. Afterwards, Galloway is looking up a ladder to the gas station roof. Climb it, and the other suspect is up there waiting. Hide behind cover and take him out.

streetCrimes.title: Running Battle
paragraphs: Shots fired at 391 Broadway, Mallory’s Café. Pursue the suspect, who shoots back at you every now and again. He heads left into an alleyway, then veers left again at the end, making it difficult to get a shot off at him. He then climbs a long pipe up to the rooftops, follow him up and then head right and jump the gap to another ladder on the second building. You’ll be able to take a shot at the suspect as he runs across the fourth rooftop after the one you are on.

streetCrimes.title: Bank Job
paragraphs: Bank of America, 7th and Olive. Uniformed officer says there are around half a dozen guys inside, and that they are real professionals. Start off behind the police car and pop up to take out the two guys behind the cars in front of you. Then get a new weapon out of the trunk of your car. Head towards the entrance to the bank and take cover on the right, unoccupied column or behind the counter with your partner. Three blips appear on the map, two on the floor and one on the stairs to the right. Take out the guy on the stairs first, as he can fire over your cover. Then aim for the other two. You may need to advance for the second one. Afterwards, head towards the door labelled “Vault”. Turn right and take the elevator down

On the lower vault floor, head towards the downed employee and find the open room to the left, and the red dots appear on your map again. Take cover behind the entry and take out the gunman in the next room. Then enter the room and see the open vault on your right. Take cover on the left side of the entrance. There’s a guy on the left that can’t hit you in cover, but you can’t get him either, so when he stops to reload, leave your cover and manually aim to take him out. Then head into the vault and charge right to cover behind the desk. Do it quickly to avoid the guy covering behind a different desk. Take him out, then head for where he was to get an aim on the final guy.

streetCrimes.title: Unsuccessful Holdup
paragraphs: Shots fired at 410 South Flower Street at Scott’s Garage. When you arrive, it seems that Scott has had enough of the guys and starts to take shots at them. The suspects take off when you arrive. Follow them around the large billboard and into a metal shack on the other side. Inside, Galloway shows you the ladder you need to climb down. Follow the hallway around until you spot the two suspects, and then take cover behind the large crate. Pop in and out to take shots at them. One may escape before you get him, but its ok, just continue onwards and find another ladder leading down into the subway tunnel. Allow the train to pass before you step onto the tracks, then go left down the tunnel to find the guys covering behind metal objects. Take them out.

streetCrimes.title: Cop Killer Shot
paragraphs: Shots fired and officer down at 6th and Lindley Place. Officers in a gun battle with two suspects on a high building. One officer suggests someone head up to take them out. First, cover behind the police car and take out the lowest of the two gunmen on the balcony. When you do, the second one moves out of range, further onto the rooftop. Follow Galloway to the alleyway and find the pipe you can climb to the balcony, then climb the ladders to the rooftop. At the top, take cover behind a pile of bricks, and you’ll see the guy taking shots at you across the rooftop. Take him out, or wait until he changes cover and run to a better spot yourself to kill him.

streetCrimes.title: Honey Boy
paragraphs: Shots fired at 313 Bunker Hill Avenue. An old couple that just moved in together had a fight, now he’s chasing her around the garden with a shotgun. Use the picket fence for cover and try to get the gunman in your sights. You get one chance at the beginning of the case to take him out from here, as he breaks cover to gun down a cop. If you miss this, then head around the back of the house and access the back porch through the unlocked door. You’ll appear behind him, and he won’t have a clue. Shoot him.

streetCrimes.title: Misunderstanding
paragraphs: Man with a gun on the corner of Union and Rockwood Street. Guy holding an Asian man at gunpoint. He kills the guy and you give chase. Follow him into a back yard, through a fence opening and into an alleyway. If you lose sight of him, pedestrians point out where he went. Cut through the back yards and follow him to the next road. He pauses when he reaches a driveway across the street. Try a warning shot here, but if you miss, he heads into a garage of a building and pauses again, giving you another chance. If you miss it this time, then time for warnings are over and he’ll start to return fire. Kill him.

streetCrimes.title: Thicker Than Water
paragraphs: Burglary suspects sighted at Lucas Avenue, between Court and Colton. The suspects flee when you arrive, so take off after them in your car. Pull alongside and allow your partner to take a shot at the tires as much as you can. The car sticks to the alleyway for a while before cutting through a construction site, and then head left onto 1st Street, another left and up an embankment. Watch for the tree as you make this jump. Eventually they veer back onto Lucas Avenue, and cut down an alleyway. If you’ve kept up with them this far, then you’ve done well, and they crash into a truck, allowing you to make the arrest.

streetCrimes.title: Killer Bandits
paragraphs: Ambulance Shooting at 943 South Broadway, Levine’s Liquor Store. Assistant shopkeeper dead, suspects fleeing on foot. You start the scene however, in a shootout in the alleyway, having spotted the guys. Concentrate on the guy who has stopped and kill him, as it's almost impossible to hit the running guy who is heading for his vehicle. When the other guys gets into his truck, roughly aim for the drivers side and use auto-aim to pile a load of bullets into his rough location and he’ll go down.

streetCrimes.title: Bowling Lane Robbery
paragraphs: Robbery at 9th and Grand at Rawling’s Bowling Alley. Armed suspect with a shotgun clears out the civilians as you arrive. You start behind your police vehicle in cover. The shotgun guy comes running out of the front door for an easy kill. Take his shotgun. Take cover by the entrance and check for the red dots. Take out the gunman near the bowling lanes just to the right. Then leave cover and slowly advance into the building while training your gun on the shoe counter to the left. Two guys, try to take them both out quickly to avoid a hostage situation. If you don’t get them both, one will run down a connecting hallway and you’ll have to chase him over the counter, where he has a hostage. Same as usual, don’t adjust your aim and he’ll put his head in the way of your bullet.
Vice Desk

streetCrimes.title: Commies
paragraphs: Robbery and shots fired at the corner of Hollywood and Highland at Hollywood First National Bank. Several hostages taken. When you start, there’s a guy at the front entrance and two covering the hostages. From where you start, pop up out of cover and take out the guy at the front entrance, avoiding the hostage. Do it before he kills the hostage himself. Now get a more powerful weapon from the trunk and head to the left exterior column. Kill the guy behind the counter, and then wait for the final guy to expose himself from the left interior.

streetCrimes.title: Fatal Plunge
paragraphs: Disturbance at the corner of Central Avenue and 7th. Fight on the rooftop, dangerously close to the edge. Finally, one guy is pushed over the edge to his death. Start by scaling the pipe by where you start, then climb the ladder on the wall on the right, bringing you to the fight scene. Dudley Lynch, from the main story, takes off running. Slide down the ladder to the left. Suspect enters a white pickup truck. Your partner arrives in your car, so hop in and get after him.

There’s only one outcome, so just try to keep up, because you can’t ram him off the road completely. Keep him in your sights as he cuts through alleyways and train yards, taking lots of sharp turns. In the second train yard, veer right to avoid being hit by the train, and make sure you’re on the right side of it, or you’ll lose Dudley as he turns off right soon after. He then enters the final train yard, and tries to get to the flood control channel, but a train cuts him off, leaving you to make the arrest.

streetCrimes.title: Against The Odds
paragraphs: Detective needs a hand to go undercover at the bookies at Sunset and Ivar. Some guy is going to place a fortune on some horse. They don’t want the guy; they want his boss, so you have to tail him. First, enter the bookies and find the empty table with a newspaper. Approach it and go incognito. The guy then enters, and lays down a grand on some horse. The suspect then leaves. Get up and start to follow.

If you stand at the entrance of the store, he’s crossing the street. He then rounds the corner past the green building. Run across the road and position yourself at the corner he went around. Watch as he walks west, then heads down an alleyway. He looks around a lot before this, so stay out of sight. When he goes down the alley, head to the entrance and cover behind the blue dumpster. Wait until he walks past the guy cleaning his pickup and all the way to the corner. It's tempting to run to the pickup, but he looks around a lot and you’ll probably get caught. He disappears around the corner to the right, so you need to run to that corner and you’ll trigger a cutscene. He’s meeting with his boss. Phelps breaks up the party and starts a gunfight.

You won’t have chance to get off a shot before they get into cover, so focus on getting to cover yourself, either behind the dumpster or the telephone box. Then focus on the boss, who will make himself visible from behind his vehicle. After he goes down, quickly concentrate on the guy you followed, before he moves his cover.

streetCrimes.title: Daylight Robbery
paragraphs: Robbery at Westlake Pest Control: 3rd and Union. As you arrive, the guy is seen leaving through the back lot and hopping over a concrete wall. Take off after him. You cannot kill the guy, or you’ll fail, but you can use a warning shot. Veer left through a yard and hurdle over a chain link fence. The suspect turns right around a privacy fence, so follow through another back yard and you’ll see him turning left around a grey two-story house. Follow him as he cuts a couple of corners, and heads between a dark grey house and a small wall. He crosses more back yards and hops a couple of fences, before running into a pedestrian and allowing you to catch up. Win the fistfight, which is easy as your partner executes a full nelson on him.

streetCrimes.title: The Blue Line
paragraphs: Multiple armed suspects at 1825 North Highland Avenue. Five hostile enemies cornered in a police secured street. You start behind cover of your car. Pop up and take out the guy you see in the cinematic, who is on the furthest right, behind the pickup. Now take cover behind the tall stack of crates and take out the guy north of your location. Then take up positions behind the bricks he was using as cover. From the left side of the cover, shoot the gunman north behind the pickup. Then move up again, this time positioning yourself in cover behind the porch of the red house. Shoot the two guys in front of you from this location then approach the garage shelter in the back yard. The last guy appears from between the vehicles and jumps into one of the cars. Try to take him out before he gets in, but if you don’t keep shooting for the drivers seat, and he’ll crash into a police car, leaving you to take him out when he exits the vehicle.

streetCrimes.title: Zoot Suit Riot
paragraphs: Robbery at 539 South Los Angeles Street at the Valor Tobacco Company. When Phelps talks to the guard, they sense that the conversation isn’t going their way and pull out guns. You start with no cover, so find some to the right and let your partner take out the guy who started the shooting. The remaining guy guards the entrance to the right. Push forward along the right wall and then take him out.

Enter the warehouse and take cover behind the first stack of boxes. You have several guys in here; one is up above you on the higher level. Move to the left side of the boxes and shoot the gunman on the left side of the lower warehouse. The second guy is also on the left side, and you can get a better angle by covering behind the slot machines close to him. From there, you should have the others in your view. Stick near the slot machines and move from the left edge to the right edge until you find a guy swapping cover. They both do this at some point. Then head upstairs to the higher floor and eliminate the last guy.

streetCrimes.title: The Badger Game
paragraphs: Reported mugging at 3155 West Fourth Street. Victim explains that some punks jumped him and took off. He tells you they went down an alleyway, then steals the nearby police car when you aren’t looking. Get into the nearest vehicle and try to catch up, as he’s got a huge lead on you. He heads west on fourth street, and then veers right into an alleyway. At the end of the alley he swerves left onto 6th, and then takes an immediate right onto Shatto Pl, then right again onto Wilshire Blvd, then left again into another alley.

He cuts across a back lot and jumps down onto a residential street. Then he turns left onto 7th for a while, before turning right into another alley, smashing through a construction yard barrier and eventually crashing. You can then finally make the arrest.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Ford V8 Sedan
vehicleOpportunities.note: Chase Vehicle option at the beginning of street crime “The Badger Game”

streetCrimes.title: Camera Obscura
paragraphs: Some guy has been taking indecent photos on a trolley car at Fountain Avenue. She points him out harassing another passer-by on the next corner. When he sees you, he gets in his car and takes off. He takes the first left onto Cole Street, then another left onto Ivar. The guy recklessly turns onto Sunset and then through a parking lot onto Cahuenga Boulevard. He drives for a block, then heads left into a parking lot, and right round the first set of buildings. He heads down Selma Avenue and left onto Steward Street., before heading back on Sunset Boulevard. He is finally struck by another vehicle on Orange Drive, and gets ploughed by a trolley car and trapped. Get out and arrest him.

streetCrimes.title: Secret Keepers
paragraphs: Security guard has apprehended a suspect at 6201 Santa Monica Boulevard, Southern California Auto Club. The guy turns out to be a reporter who was apparently following a guy wanted by the feds. He’s in the parking lot out back. Head outside and see where the red dot appears, then head there. The suspect gets into his nice car and drives off. Get into the nearest vehicle and give chase. Follow him closely as he heads out of the lot and through some back alleys. The suspect then takes a sharp turn onto Afton Place, before taking a left onto Gower, and a right onto El Centro, and left through a parking lot that looks like an airplane hangar. Eventually he hits the side of a building allowing you to arrest him.

streetCrimes.title: Bad Date
paragraphs: Homicide at the alleyway at Union and 7th, suspect at large. The victim was seen leaving a bar with a guy and then becoming shy at his advances, so he got angry. Examine the head to find the blunt force trauma, then look at the blood stains on the floor where Earle is looking. There are bloody footprints heading away from the scene. Follow them to a gutter that you can climb, and you’ll see the suspect climbing a ladder to a higher level. Follow him up and search until you find him to initiate a fist fight. He’s a tough cookie, so make sure to dodge plenty before laying into him. Likely he’ll be grounded a few times before you can slap the cuffs on him.
Arson Desk

streetCrimes.title: Accident Prone
paragraphs: Hit and Run at the intersection of 6th and Alvarado. Apparently the suspect has ditched his car and left on foot down a nearby alleyway. Head left into the first alley and find him behind the red trailer. Easy fistfight with your partner's help to take him in.

streetCrimes.title: Paper Sack Holdup
paragraphs: Time Available 19:00 - 7:00

Robbery at 253 Main Street Bank of Arcadia. Two guys have made off with about 10 grand in a paper bag. Some drunkard says he saw them in the car park. You find the suspects jacking a car, so take the nearest car for yourself and take off after them. They head south on Spring Street, and then right into another parking lot to head down an alleyway. Stay close so your partner can take his shots, but don’t try to pull up beside the suspect, as the alley is too narrow. Out of the alleys, the robbers turn right onto 4th and cut into the first alley on the right. When they leave this alley, you have a great chance to slam into their left side as they turn onto Olive, to cause major damage. Do the same on the next two intersections and you’ll probably stop them, but if you don’t they eventually take a large jump and disintegrate their car allowing you to make the arrest.

vehicleOpportunities.name: Voisin C7
vehicleOpportunities.note: In an Alaco station in Hollywood where Sunset Blvd and La Brea meet. You can also find it in the Hall of Records parking lot during the “Quarter Moon Murders”, and also you drive it in the street crime “Paper Sack Holdup”

streetCrimes.title: Café Holdup
paragraphs: Holdup at Boos Brothers Café at 522 South Hill Street. Head inside to see an employee with a gun wound. You hear the suspects threatening the staff in the parking lot behind the café. You have five seconds to take out the guy before he shoots his hostage, but it's an easy shot. After this, don’t worry about the civilians as the rest of the gang take cover. Take cover behind the crates as you exit the door. A Car brings one more enemy, making for three. Biggest threats are on the far right and far left either side. Take these out first and then eliminate the last guy behind the vehicle.

streetCrimes.title: Bus Stop Shooting
paragraphs: Officer at Greyhound Bus Station at Beverly and Union. Girl's been shot, and there are still people inside. You begin in cover behind a cop car. Reach into the trunk and pull out a better weapon. Then run for cover behind the bus depot entrance. Three dots appear on your minimap, one should be visible so take him out quickly. Next, work your way towards the left corner to get a visual of the next gunman, and take him out. The final guy runs through the back door to the bus parking lot. Head after him. He gets one guy to support him, so hide behind the buses as cover and take them out when you get the opportunity.

streetCrimes.title: Hot Property
paragraphs: Burglary at 38 North Catalina. Guy is trying to break into the house and enter. When he sees you he takes off running, and enters his pickup truck to escape. Chase north after him, and he heads slightly right through the intersection to cut through a parking lot, then enters the alleyway on the left. Stay close to have your partner shoot out his tires. After the Oakwood Intersection, the suspect veers right again through a residential alley and turns left around the first house, turning left on Rosewood. Afterwards, he cuts straight through a diner parking lot, and left onto Mariposa, where he’ll crash into a delivery truck, allowing you to make the arrest and complete your final street crime.

vehicles.story: Usually across the street from the police station in “The Driver’s Seat”

vehicles.name: Nash Deluxe 600 Army
vehicles.location: South Hollywood, Hughes Airplane Company on Van Ness Ave

vehicles.name: American La France Fire Truck
vehicles.story: at the start of “Manifest Destiny”, leave the Vice Precinct and the fire station is directly opposite

vehicles.name: Buick Ambulance
vehicles.location: Central, West Central, between Beacon and Union (not the usual ambulance)

vehicles.name: Dodge Fuel Truck
vehicles.location: Wilshire, often around 3rd and 4th streets at Alameda

vehicles.name: Ford Ambulance
vehicles.story: Easiest is at the Coroner’s office during “A Match Made in Heaven”

vehicles.name: International Metro KB1M
vehicles.location: Wilshire, South Wilshire around Vermont Ave/8th street

vehicles.name: International KB5
vehicles.story: Best place for this is in “Manifest Destiny”. When the sniper is shooting you, sneak around to the alley on the left (behind you when you start), and the truck will be waiting for you there.

vehicles.name: International D Series
vehicles.story: Parked in a parking lot east of the blood stained door in “Upon Reflection”

vehicles.name: Heil Colecto-Pak
vehicles.location: Central, Look for them around the Mayfair Hotel landmark

vehicles.name: International KB8
vehicles.location: the parking lot of the Polar Bear Ice Company on the West end of Hawthorn Ave in West Hollywood on the corner with La Brea Ave. Very similar to the 1. International KB8 but has distinct Polar Bear Ice Truck Company markings on the side.

vehicles.name: International KB6
vehicles.story: There should also be one opposite Schroeder’s apartment in “Upon Reflection”, behind a climbable fence.

vehicles.name: Chevrolet Fleetmaster 2Dr (Note: this is not the same as the civilian Fleetmaster 2Dr)
Chevrolet Coroner’s Van
vehicles.location: can be found at most crime scenes

vehicles.name: Nash Super 600 (Note: this is not the same as the Super 600 civilian version)
vehicles.location: Rusty’s car in the Homicide cases

vehicles.name: Studebaker Commander (Note: this is not the same as the Commander civilian version)
vehicles.location: Parked near many crime scenes. You can get it in “The Driver’s Seat” if you get straight in it before you go into the crime scene itself.

vehicles.name: Cadillac Town Car
vehicles.location: In Hollywood, in the garage of the Alaco station on the corner of Broson Ave and Fountain Ave.

vehicles.name: Chrysler Woody
vehicles.location: Residential Garage at the end of a long alleyway west of where 7th and Vermont Ave meet in Wilshire.

vehicles.name: Cisitalia Coupe
vehicles.location: Wilshire Division 7, hidden behind the Angel City Security garage door of an Alaco station on the corner of Vermont Ave and Melrose Ave. You actually may have this, as you can use it to chase James Tiernan out the back of Rawling’s Bowling Alley in “The Studio Secretary Murder”

vehicles.name: Cord 810 Softtop
vehicles.location: Find the old two story building on Mateo Street, right at the southern part of the map. It's on a sublevel of this building, down a slope going behind it. Alternatively, this car can be driven during the street crime “Hotel Bandits” as a chase car.

vehicles.name: Davis Deluxe
vehicles.location: Residential garage on the border of Hollywood and Wilshire, near Melrose Ave between Wilton Place and Western Ave.

vehicles.name: Delage D8 120
vehicles.location: Find the L-shaped alleyway between Beacon and Union Ave at the southwest side of Central, about 4 blocks east of MacArthur Park. It can be accessed from a side street off of Union Avenue, at the bottom of a 13 story building.

vehicles.name: Delage D8 120 S Poutout Aero-co
vehicles.location: Residential Garage in East Hollywood. Look for a grey building with white trim on the corner of Normandie Ave and Lemongrove Ave

vehicles.name: Delahaye 135MS Cabriolet
vehicles.location: Adjacent to the shopping area where you found the fourth film reel, right at the north end of Hollywood. The house is huge, and the garage is attached to it, but obscured by some trees. The garage door has the Angel City Security logo on it.

vehicles.name: Duesenberg Walker Coupe
vehicles.location: On the corner of Santa Monica Blvd and El Centro Ave in Hollywood, in the garage behind the Automobile Club of Southern California

vehicles.name: Phantom Corsair
vehicles.location: Corner of 3rd and Traction Avenue in Central, inside the Alaco Station

vehicles.name: Stout Scarab
vehicles.location: There’s a tall, 5 story building to the east of the Los Angeles River between 4th street and Wittler Blvd, with an Angel City Security Garage door, under a small tin roof.

vehicles.name: Talbot GS26
vehicles.notes: Hidden inside an Alaco station in Central LA, on the corner of 6th and Bixel St

vehicles.name: Tucker Torpedo
vehicles.location: Hidden in a small brick garage that is wedged between two buildings in Wilshire, on the corner of Oakwood and Western Ave. You must access it from the rear parking lot

vehicles.name: Voisin C7
vehicles.location: In an Alaco station in Hollywood where Sunset Blvd and La Brea meet. You can also find it in the Hall of Records parking lot during the “Quarter Moon Murders”, and also you drive it in the street crime “Paper Sack Holdup”

vehicles.name: Ford H Boy
vehicles.location: on the corner of Beverly Blvd and Kingsley Drive, Wilshire.

weapons.name: Colt .45
weapons.note: Phelps' default weapon; it has unlimited ammunition.

weapons.name: Colt .38
weapons.note: Available in Armed and Dangerous. Drop your shotgun and you will be armed with this.

weapons.name: Ithaca Full Stock Shotgun
weapons.note: You start with it in Armed and Dangerous; it can also be taken from the boot of any police car.

weapons.name: M1 Thompson
weapons.note: Commonly carried by enemies, especially during The Black Caesar.

weapons.name: Chicago Piano Gun
weapons.note: The free DLC places one in your car boot. Without it, the Manifest Destiny alley shootout can yield one; take down the automatic-weapon enemy first.

weapons.name: BAR
weapons.note: Available in Manifest Destiny, A Polite Invitation and A Different Kind of War.

weapons.name: FN Browning
weapons.note: Jack Kelso's primary weapon during his playable Arson cases.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.note: Only found in the sewer weapon caches during A Different Kind of War. Save this for last if you want a clear confirmation that the weapon set is complete.
